abstract: An accelerator unit in conjunction with generalized pairwise optimization can obtain optimum geometric shaped 64QAM constellations up to 60% faster. Shaping gain and transmission distance are improved over just GPO constellations in low-to-middle SNR regimes.

articleTitle: Simplifying Datacenter Networks with the 100G/channel Optics Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The intersection of a 100Gb/s/channel ecosystem for optical and electrical links in combination with emerging 512-channel switch silicon offers unprecedented potential for simplifying datacenter network architectures.

articleTitle: Ultra-wide Bandwidth Thin-film LiNbO3 Modulator with Record-Low Half-wave-voltage Length Product
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Novel electro-optic modulators are fabricated based on LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-silica hybrid waveguide and capacitively-loaded electrodes. Record-low half-wave-voltage length product of 1.7 V•cm and modulation bandwidth > 67 GHz are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generalized carrier assisted differential detection with simplified receiver structure
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the generalized carrier assisted differential detection schemes with reduced hardware complexity, which requires the same number of photodiodes and ADCs as the coherent homodyne counterpart but without the narrow-linewidth local oscillators. The performance of the simplified receiver is evaluated by 60-Gbaud 16-QAM OFDM signals.

articleTitle: Toward 6G: A New Era of Convergence [Invited]
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper highlights some of the 6G driving trends and reports on early findings, starting from an optical fiber networks perspective all the way to human-avatar/robot collectives and extended reality in the 6G post-smartphone era.

articleTitle: Brillouin Phase Spectrum Recovery based on Kramers-Kronig relation in Direct-detection BOTDA sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Without the need of coherent detection and hardware modification, Brillouin phase spectrum is digitally recovered for the first time from the Brillouin gain spectrum based on Kramers-Kronig relation in a conventional direct-detection BOTDA sensing system.

articleTitle: Photonic-Assisted Microwave OFDM Quantum-Noise Randomized Cipher Generation via IM/DD IFoF Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an IM/DD IF-over-Fiber system that delivers and generates OFDM quantum-noise randomized cipher for secure wireless communications. A 3.6-GHz IF 4.09-Gbit/s PSK cipher with sufficient signal masking by shot noise is generated.

articleTitle: Polarization Rotation enhanced Nonlinear-optical Loop Mirror (PR-NOLM) Multilevel Amplitude Regenerator
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a polarization rotation enhanced nonlinear-optical loop mirror (PR-NOLM)-based multilevel amplitude regenerator to significantly improve the noise suppression performance, achieving the total improvement including 188% of regeneration-range and 4.5dB SNR in the novel scheme.

articleTitle: Adaptive Pattern-Dependent Equalization for Coherent Optical Fiber Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a pattern-dependent equalization scheme facilitating sequence detection in systems with pattern-dependent impairment(s). We experimentally demonstrate effective detection of a 60-GBd QPSK signal with a constrained transmitter bandwidth down to 7.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Giant Brillouin Amplification in Gas Using Hollow-core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical amplification in hollow core fibers has been achieved using stimulated Brillouin scattering directly in the gaseous medium. More than 50 dB optical gain is observed over 50 m of fiber using 200 mW of pump power.

articleTitle: Using DIALux and Regression-based Machine Learning Algorithm for Designing Indoor Visible Light Positioning (VLP) and Reducing Training Data Collection
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate using DIALux software with regression-machine-learning for designing visible-light-positioning (VLP) systems. Besides, the proposed scheme can also reduce the burden of training data collection in VLP systems.

articleTitle: Butt-Coupled III-V Photodetector Monolithically Integrated on SOI with data reception at 50 Gbps OOK
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first in-plane waveguide butt-coupled high-speed III-V p-i-n photodetector monolithically integrated on standard SOI and demonstrate data reception at 50 GBd using OOK and a 3 dB cut-off frequency approaching 70 GHz.

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network for Mitigating Transmission Impairments of 160 Gbit/s PAM4 Microring Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and design a Long-Short-Term-Memory (LSTM) algorithm to mitigate transmission impairments of 4-level-pulse-amplitude-modulation (PAM4) produced by silicon-microring-modulator (Si-MRM). 160-Gbit/s PAM4 over 1-km single-mode-fiber (SMF) is achieved satisfying the pre-forward-error-correction (FEC) requirement.

articleTitle: A New FOWLP Platform for Hybrid Optical Packaging - Demonstration on 100Gbps Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The Fan Out Wafer Level Packaging, widely used in the silicon semiconductor system, is introduced for all-in-one hybrid optical package with small form factor, potentially higher performance, and expendability to on-board/co-packaged optical interconnections. To prove the new packaging idea, 100GBASE-SR4 standard is targeted in this demonstration.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a 1-Gbit/s "Pin-like" Low-Divergence Beam Using a Limited-Sized Receiver Aperture at Various Distances
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 1-Gbit/s free-space optical data communication link using a pin-like beam. The results show that the pin-like beam has ~8dB less power loss induced by the limited-size receiver aperture at various distances compared with a Gaussian beam.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Circulant Multiplexing based on the Chirp-Like Polyphase Sequence in Short-Reach IM/DD Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel orthogonal circulant multiplexing technique based on the chirp-like polyphase sequence and show in 115.8-Gbit/s IM/DD experiments with 10-GHz-class devices that this scheme outperforms OFDM, DFT-spread OFDM, OCT-precoded OFDM and OCDM.

articleTitle: Sensitivity improvement for silicon MS-SW BG sensors by waveguide height increase or by waveguide suspension with supporting shape modification
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Two methods for refractive index sensitivity improvement of silicon SW-MS BG refractive index sensors were considered. Height parameter was optimized and suspended waveguides were introduced. Experimentally obtained values were 850 nm/RIU and 1100 nm/RIU, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimizations of thin glass diameter fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Thin diameter fibers with 80μm cladding diameters were designed and fabricated. The limitation of total fiber diameters was investigated for step- and 2-types trench-index fibers taking ITU-T standard, micro-bending loss, and mechanical reliabilities, into account.

articleTitle: 465 Gbps Single Side Band Direct Detection Transmission over 40 km of SSMF using a Single-ended Photodiode
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel adaptive algorithm to mitigate simultaneously the O/E front-end response and the SSBI in SSB direct detection transmissions and demonstrate a net data rate of 465 Gb/s over 40 km of SSMF using a single-ended photodiode.

articleTitle: Trans-Atlantic Real-Time Field Trial Using Super-Gaussian Constellation-Shaping to Enable 30Tb/s+ Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A record real-time capacity capability of 30.01Tb/s is demonstrated across a 6644km trans-Atlantic subsea link using super-Gaussian shaped PS-64QAM. We additionally report the first 700Gb/s payload transmission at 100.4GBaud across the same route.

articleTitle: Wavelength Collision-Free and Low-Loss Full-Duplex Transmission over Switchable Full-Coupling or Half-Split Coherent WDM-PON System with Shared Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose low-loss and high-tolerance shared protection for full-duplex coherent wavelength division multiplexing-passive optical network systems, achieving < 2 dB penalty with small back reflection in wavelength collision-free secondary link transmissions with primary link failure.

articleTitle: Single-photodiode 100 Gbaud PAM-6 Transmission with Extended Transmitter Bandwidth using Optical Time and Polarization Interleaving
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical time and polarization interleaving (OTPI) technique to extend the transmitter bandwidth. Using a single photodiode, 25-GHz DACs and modulators, 100 Gbaud OTPI-PAM-6 signals have been transmitted over 1 km NZDSF.

articleTitle: Advanced Single-Mode 850 nm VCSELs for Record NRZ and PAM4 Data Rate on SMF-28 Fiber up to 1 km
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Temperature-stable single-mode 850 nm VCSELs with integrated mode-selective filters are developed and demonstrated record NRZ 38 Gb/s (25 °C), NRZ 32 Gb/s (70 °C) and PAM4 32 GBaud (25 °C) on 1 km standard single-mode fiber (SMF-28).

articleTitle: Time-energy Entangled Photon Pairs Generated via SFWM in an AlGaAsOI Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a time-energy entangled photon pair source from an AlGaAs microring resonator with an internal generation rate greater than 20×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> pairs sec<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> mW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> while maintaining high heralded single photon purity > 99% and visibility > 97%.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Oversampling-Downsampling Technique for High SNR Fiber Distributed Acoustic Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A spatio-temporal oversampling-downsampling fiber DAS system is proposed and demonstrated. Without increasing the complexity and cost of the system, the demodulated SNR can be increased by 15dB, and the fading noise can be completely eliminated.

articleTitle: 5.5%-Δ-PLC/Silicon Photonics Hybrid Wavelength MUX/DEMUX-and-Switch Device
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel hybrid integration scheme by demonstrating a polarization-insensitive low-crosstalk 8 × 8 silicon photonics switch butt-jointed with a compact extremely-high-Δ SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-based 100-GHz 8-ch AWG, which exploits performance advantages of each platform.

articleTitle: Polymer Waveguide-coupled Co-packaged Silicon Photonics-die Embedded Package Substrate
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a next generation co-packaged substrate using Si photonics dies, a polymer optical waveguide, and a optical connector to achieve beyond 10 Tb/s and WDM optical links. The two micro-mirrors and polymer waveguides were integrated, and their optical characteristics were evaluated.

articleTitle: Gb/s Secure Key Distribution Based on Synchronization of Polarization States
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a high-speed physical-layer key distribution in fiber networks using synchronization of polarization states. An error-free and true random key generation rate of 2 Gb/s is achieved over 20 km single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Towards Co-Existence of 100 Gbps Classical Channel Within a WDM Quantum Entanglement Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally prove the feasibility of wavelength multiplexing bright 100 Gbps classical communication with multiple single-photon level entanglement channels over SMF-28e fibre in a quantum network. This minimises the resources needed for quantum networks.

articleTitle: Silicon-Photonics-Based Spectroscopic Sensing for Environmental Monitoring and Health Care
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Spectroscopic sensing is a powerful modality for numerous applications in medicine, biotechnology and structural health monitoring. Often the implementation is bulky or costly, which is a barrier for high volume markets. Integrated photonics - in particular silicon and silicon nitride photonics - is changing this and will boost spectroscopic sensing to such markets, for example in personalized medicine. This tutorial will discuss underlying principles, technologies and application cases.

articleTitle: Benchmarking of Carrier Phase Recovery Circuits for M-QAM Coherent Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We benchmark blind carrier phase recovery DSP circuits in terms of SNR penalty, power dissipation, latency, area usage, and cycle slip probability, to identify optimal implementations for 16, 64, and 256QAM.

articleTitle: 8-ch, 160-nm-Wavelength-Range Membrane Laser Array Using Selective Epitaxy on InP-on-Insulator Substrate
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We fabricate an 8-ch 160-nm-range membrane laser array with selectively grown InGaAlAs-MQWs on a thin InP layer on SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si. By controlling the material gain peak and lasing wavelength, all lasers exhibit 32-Gbit/s NRZ direct modulation.

articleTitle: Photonics Vision 2030 in Africa
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Africa holds a rich history that suggests the successful adoption of the fourth industrial revolution driven by photonics. This paper connects the dots and plots or projects how photonics in Africa might be in 2030.

articleTitle: Design Rules for Multi-Mode Anti-Resonant Hollow-Core Fibres
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Hollow-core fibres typically guide a single low-loss, degenerate spatial mode. Here we present techniques to design HCFs guiding multiple modes with low loss that could be employed in short-haul datacoms or in power delivery. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 147-Gb/s Transmission of Optical Single Sideband DMT Signal Generated by Dual Modulation of DML and EAM
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a record transmission of 147-Gb/s (net 122-Gb/s) optical single sideband discrete multi-tone signal, generated by modulating both a directly modulated laser and an electro-absorption modulator, over an 80-km C-band link.

articleTitle: Entanglement Blocking in DLCZ-based Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Resource and performance dependent blocking mechanisms for entanglement routing in quantum networks are identified and characterized in simulations of a DLCZ architecture under different loss and resource availability conditions.

articleTitle: Principal axes twist of antiresonant hollow-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present measurements of antiresonant hollow-core fiber principal axes twist and orientation under different bend conditions in the spectral region of 2.26 – 2.36 µm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Fourier Transform Enabled Multiple Pulses Purification for Soliton Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Nonlinear Fourier transform (NFT) enabled soliton distillation is exploited to purify multiple pulses from an ultrafast fiber laser, which paves a way to manipulate the soliton separation and revives soliton communication.

articleTitle: Phase Retrieval-Based Coherent Receivers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare the fundamental performance of Kramers-Kronig detection to that of standard local oscillator-based coherent detection and standard direct detection in optically amplified links, highlighting the effects of the carrier-to-signal power ratio, chromatic dispersion, and probabilistic shaping.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient Downstream 100 Gb/s PolMux Multi-CAP OSSB transmission and coherent reception Using 10G Electronics for Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a 100Gb/s downstream PON link based on a PolMux, multi-CAP OSSB modulation signal received by a coherent receiver. 50km transmission is achieved using 10G electronic and photonic devices with a sensitivity of -20dBm.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength Gratings Assisted Ridge Waveguide Surface Couplers on Lithium Niobate Thin Film
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A thin-film lithium niobate ridge-waveguide grating coupler integrated with waveguide subwavelength gratings is experimentally demonstrated. An ultra-high coupling efficiency of -5.1 dB/coupler for TE polarization and over 90 nm 3-dB optical bandwidth are achieved.

articleTitle: Master-slave synchronization of random microcavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the interaction and synchronization of random microcavity lasers. In this way, a spectral coding method is proposed, providing a potential technique to generate and share information between disordered nodes.

articleTitle: 4×10 Gb/s WDM Fiber Wireless multi-IFoF Reconfigurable Fronthaul using a low-loss Si3N4 ROADM for mmWave 5G
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Four 10 Gb/s multi-IFoF 16-QAM WDM Fiber-Wireless links are transmitted through 10km fiber and 50cm directional V-band antennas and flexibly reconfigured by a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ROADM, towards record 40 Gb/s wavelength-routed fronthaul capacity for mmWave 5G.

articleTitle: Hyperscale Datacenter Networks with Hybrid Fabric Aggregator Architectures
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel datacenter architecture called hybrid fabric aggregator that can connect over 1 Million servers. This design offers higher scalability, lower path cost and lower power consumptions compared to the Facebook F16 topology.

articleTitle: Automated Cloning and Lookup Table Generation for Reconfigurable Photonic Integrated Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a strategy to automatically replicate the spectral response of photonic filters, here applied to coupled microring resonator architectures. This control scheme is exploited to generate Lookup Tables for devices operating in flexible networks.

articleTitle: Simplifying Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution with Directly Modulated Laser Sources
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a new MDI-QKD system design employing gain-switched, injection-locked lasers to directly generate GHz-clock-rate encoded states, greatly simplifying MDI-QKD and improving state-of-the-art performance by an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics Coherent Optical Subassembly for High-Data-Rate Signal Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present silicon photonics coherent optical subassemblies for digital coherent optical systems. We also demonstrate up to 96-Gbaud 16QAM transmission experiments.

articleTitle: Stateful DBA Hypervisor Supporting SLAs with Low Latency & High Availability in Shared PON
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a stateful DBA hypervisor for shared PONs capable of meeting specific flow-level service level agreements, supporting services requiring strict latency and high availability. We report considerable improvement compared to standard stateless priority-based mechanisms.

articleTitle: Wireless Body-Area Networks in Medical Applications Using Optical Signal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider optical wireless technology-based medical wireless body-area networks (WBANs). After presenting the most recent results on channel modeling and signal transmission, a new multiple access MAC layer scheme is proposed for intra-WBAN links.

articleTitle: BOW: First Real-World Demonstration of a Firewall-based Bayesian Optimization System for Wavelength Deployment
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a practical Bayesian Optimization system for wavelength deployment at Facebook optical backbone. Our system uses a firewall for safe deployment. It is open-source, compatible with any vendor, and achieves 4.76× faster wavelength deployment.

articleTitle: Quantum Key Secured Communications Field Trial for Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We seamlessly integrate quantum key distribution with >1Mb/s secure bit rate into a smart-manufacturing production network. This provides a 10Gb/s quantum key encrypted link with long-term stable operation, compatible with national network infrastructure.

articleTitle: 360-Channel WDM-MDM Transmission over 25-km Ring-Core Fiber with Low-Complexity Modular 4×4 MIMO Equalization
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transmission of 12 OAM modes each carrying 30 wavelengths with 11.52-Tbit/s capacity over 25-km specially designed ring-core fiber has been successfully demonstrated, using 4 ×4 modular MIMO equalization with tap number no more than 25.

articleTitle: First Experimental Demonstration of Flexible Rate PON Beyond 100Gb/s with Probabilistic and Geometric Shaping
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The pairwise probabilistic combined with geometric shaping is applied to IMDD system. With shaped PAM signals, the flexible information rate beyond 100Gb/s is experimentally demonstrated for the first time in a practical PON link.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Translucent C-band and Transparent C+L-band Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compare transparent and translucent network design in terms of capacity, energy consumption, and cost. Results show that exploiting extra spectrum bands is more beneficial than deploying additional regenerators in the C-band.

articleTitle: A Quantum-Dash Dual-Wavelength DFB Laser for Optical Millimeter-Wave Radio-over-Fiber Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical-heterodyne millimeter-wave radio-over-fiber system with broadband wireless links through 25.22 km standard-single-mode fiber featuring a high bitrate of 24-Gb/s (64QAM × 4GBaud) using a highly correlated InAs/InP quantum-dash dual-wavelength DFB laser.

articleTitle: Leveraging ML-based QoT Tool Parameter Feeding for Accurate WDM Network Performance Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel technique to refine optical fiber network parameters for accurate performance estimation is presented. The technique exploits Raman and Kerr effects to improve new services’ SNR estimation accuracy by 2dB based on experimental data.

articleTitle: Process Variation-Aware Photonic Design
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present methods for variation-aware compact models, adjoint-based particle defect analysis, and variation extraction for photonic components. These methods can expedite ensemble simulations and enable design-for-manufacturability to increase yield in photonic integrated circuit design.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Machine-Intelligent Soft-Failure Localization Using SDN Telemetry
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a soft-failure localization framework using SDN-based network-wide telemetry. Soft failures are generated in a small-scale laboratory environment and collected in an SDN architecture. Failure localization is accomplished by ML algorithms.

articleTitle: Combining Long-Short Term Memory and Reinforcement Learning for Improved Autonomous Network Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A combined LSTM and RL approach is proposed for dynamic connection capacity allocation. The LSTM predictor anticipates periodical long-term sharp traffic changes and extends short-term RL knowledge. Numerical results show remarkable performance.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Reception of ASK-based AMCC Signals and QPSK Signals with Single Coherent Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An AMCC signal extraction method for a single coherent receiver is proposed. Experiments demonstrate the successful decoding of a 25 Gbps QPSK-signal and 128 kbps AMCC-signal with the penalty of less than 0.1 dB.

articleTitle: Towards Low Computational Complexity for Neural Network-Based Equalization in PAM4 Short-Reach Direct Detection Systems by Multi-Symbol Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose NN-based multi-symbol equalization for a 50-Gb/s PAM4 direct-detection link which significantly reduces computational complexity without sacrificing BER performance of conventional single-output NNs. Complexity reduction of 42.7% is achieved when 8 outputs are selected.

articleTitle: Single- vs. Multi-Band Optimized Power Control in C+L WDM 400G Line Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an optimal strategy for C+L multi-band power control assessing its performance against a single-band one. Via SSFM simulations, we demonstrate that the L-band can be optimized independently.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Software-defined Key Management for Quantum Key Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a practical key management scheme for a quantum key distribution network. Multi-vendor QKD systems are interoperated via a standard interface and a key relay is dynamically routed by SDN.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstrations of Concurrent Adaptive Inter-ONU and Upstream Communications in IMDD Hybrid SSB OFDM-DFMA PONs
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Concurrent adaptive inter-ONU and upstream communications are experimentally demonstrated in 25km@101.6Gbit/s IMDD hybrid SSB OFDM-DFMA PONs, offering a promising candidate to meet 5G and beyond networks’ requirements in terms of latency, bitrate and connection density.

articleTitle: All-Optical Bi-Directional Polarization Demultiplexing for Self-Homodyne Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An all-optical bi-directional polarization demultiplexing self-homodyne coherent system is proposed. In the 120-Gbit/s 16-QAM experimental demonstration, one adaptive polarization controller is applied to lock the polarization of uplink and downlink light at the same time.

articleTitle: Modeling of Nonlinear Interference Power for Dual-Polarization 4D Formats
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We assess the accuracy of a recently introduced nonlinear interference model for general dual-polarization 4D formats. Unlike previous models for polarization-multiplexed 2D formats, an average gap from split-step Fourier simulations within 0.1 dB is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-Loss Three-Dimensional Fan-in/Fan-out Devices for Multi-Core Fiber Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 3D fan-in/fan-out device for multi-core fiber integration fabricated by ultrafast laser inscription using an automatic 3D waveguide routing algorithm. The low propagation loss of 0.3 dB/cm and 0.16 dB/cm have been achieved for two types of glasses.

articleTitle: A Non-Proprietary Network Operations Platform for OpenROADM Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Key functionalities of NOP (Network Operations Platform) are demonstrated with the latest multi-vendor OpenROADM equipment. Using open source packages, the NOP inter-operates with TransportPCE and other controllers, bringing together information about topology, events, and metrics.

articleTitle: Capacity Scaling Through Spatial Parallelism: From Subsea Cables to Short-reach Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Spatial parallelism is the only way to continue the exponential capacity scaling of optical networks. We discuss trade-offs and implications of spatial parallelism from ultra-long-haul subsea cables and terrestrial mesh networks to short-reach optical links.

articleTitle: High-performance 100 Gbaud Coherent Photonic Modules
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 1.6 Tb/s optical engine is enabled through vertical integration of a 2-channel monolithic InP PIC with SiGe electronics and a real-time DSP ASIC operating at 100 Gbaud for 800 Gb/s transmission.

articleTitle: A BiLSTM-CNN based Multitask Learning Approach for Fiber Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel multitask learning approach based on stacked bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) networks and convolutional neural networks (CNN) for detecting, locating, characterizing, and identifying fiber faults is proposed. It outperforms conventionally employed techniques.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 800-Gbit/s/carrier TPS-64QAM WDM Transmission over 2,000 km Using MIMO Volterra Equalization
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a 125-GHz-grid WDM coherent transmission over 2,000-km Raman amplified ULAF with 800-Gbit/s/carrier net-bit-rate based on 100-Gbaud truncated PS-64QAM. Our results show that the MIMO-VNLE outperforms the SISO-VNLE by around 67% reach improvement.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of 400ZR DWDM Transmission through Field Deployable Hollow-Core-Fibre Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report characterisation of ISRS, Kerr-nonlinearity and the first demonstration of error-free DWDM transmission with 38×400G signals using commercial 400ZR QSFP-DD modules through a field deployable 10.25km hollow-core NANF cable with <1.2dB/km loss from 1525-1625nm.

articleTitle: An OFDM-MIMO Distributed Acoustic Sensing over Deployed Telecom Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the performance of a novel multi-carrier MIMO fiber sensing interrogator based on OFDM approach. Over an installed telecom fiber cable, coherent fading is mitigated by means of a purely digital subcarrier combiner. © 2020 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Digital twin-enabled Power Optimizer for Multi-span Transmission System Using Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A digital twin-enabled technique is proposed for multi-span system to build a neural network-based power prediction model and an autoencoder-based power optimization model achieve flexible output spectrum profile control.

articleTitle: Transmission of 200-GBaud PDM Probabilistically Shaped 64-QAM Signals Modulated via a 100-GHz Thin-film LiNbO3 I/Q Modulator
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 102-GHz DBI-DAC and 100-GHz I/Q modulator enabled PDM 200GBaud probabilistically shaped 64-QAM signal carrying up to 7.92 information bits/symbol/2polarization. A net data rate of 1.58 Tb/s is achieved on a single wavelength.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Uncoupled Six-core Fibers in Standard Cladding Diameter Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on ultra-wide-band and long-haul compatible 125µm six-core trenchassisted fiber designs. The AI-optimization process considers crosstalk, effective area, and bandwidth. We show that homogeneous cores can lead to low complexity yet high capacity fiber.

articleTitle: Overcoming the Quantum Noise Limit with Continuous-wave Phase-Sensitive Parametric Amplification Based on a Single Integrated Silicon-Nitride Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate continuous-wave phase-sensitive optical parametric amplification with 9.5 dB gain and a 1.2 dB noise figure, well below the conventional 3 dB quantum limit, using a single compact and dispersion-engineered integrated nonlinear Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguide.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Symbol-rate Rx DSP for Short-Reach Optical Coherent Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an efficient low-power symbol-rate Rx DSP scheme for short-reach optical coherent systems targeting DCI scenarios. Compared with typical sampling rate of 2 sample/symbol, the power consumption of both Rx DSP and ADC can be reduced by ~50%.

articleTitle: A novel method for distributed phase birefringence measurement based on chirped pulse φ-OTDR
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel method for phase birefringence measurement is theoretically analyzed and experimentally demonstrated. By using the chirped pulses, the local birefringence could be directly measured based on local time delays of reflected Rayleigh traces between slow and fast axes. The birefringence measurement resolution is up to 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9.</sup>

articleTitle: Experimental verification of 64-Gbd/64-QAM interworking of probabilistic shaping with a digital resolution enhancer
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an experimental study of probabilistic constellation shaping gains in low resolution digital-to-analogue converter based transceivers, which utilizes digital resolution enhancement. A SNR gain of 0.65dB for optimized probabilistic shaping factors can be achieved.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a RF-Source-Free Microwave Photonic Radar Based on an Optically Injected Semiconductor Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel RF-source-free microwave photonic radar has been proposed and experimentally demonstrated based on an optically injected semiconductor laser. Real-time high-resolution target detection is achieved without the requirement of any external RF sources.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Radiation-Induced Optical Transients on Deep-Space Optical Communications Systems using PPM
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An analysis on the effects of radiation-induced optical transients in a communications link using PPM is presented. The probability of symbol errors is shown to increase due to ionizing radiation-induced depletion of the optical signal.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Fourier Transform based Blind Frequency Offset Estimation for PS-QAM in W-band Fiber-Millimeter Wave Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Blind FOE for PS-QAM is experimentally analyzed in fiber-mmWave integrated system. QS-FOE can relax the requirements on FFT size, shaping factor and laser linewidth of the FFT-FOE by improving PMNR by more than 10 dB.

articleTitle: Real-Time 400G CFP2-DCO Using 69GBaud/DP-16QAM- PS Over 1000km 75GHz-Spaced DWDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A <26.5W pluggable CFP2-DCO module using 69 Gbaud/DP-16QAM-PS is demonstrated for the first time to carry a net 424.9 Gb/s over a 75GHz-spaced 1000km DWDM link with a 4.5-dB OSNR margin.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Impairment Compensation Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Neural networks are attractive for nonlinear impairment compensation applications in communication systems. In this paper, several approaches to reduce computational complexity of the neural network-based algorithms are presented.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Circuits for Terahertz Communication: The Hybrid Integrated Microwave Photonic approach
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical heterodyne signal generation is the most flexible photonic microwave generation technique. Photonic integrated solutions have been shown monolithically on InP, and more recently on silicon. We present novel implementations using hybrid integration technology with silicon nitride (with high-Q resonators for extremely low linewidth) and polymer (with low permittivity material for highly efficient radiation).

articleTitle: Demonstration of Single-Lane 350-Gb/s PS-PAM-16 in the C-band using single-DAC for Data Center Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated single-lane 100-Gbaud PAM-8 and PS-PAM-16 signals IM/DD transmission over 1-km NZDSF using one single-DAC and single-Photodiode with joint nonlinear equalization techniques. 350-Gb/s PS-PAM-16 signal transmission can be achieved.

articleTitle: Capturing value from latency control in time-slotted optical communications: a techno-economic assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We assess the value of deterministic latency and propose pricing models to monetize this network feature. We show how to achieve a threefold monetary return increase in certain network configurations and time-sensitive application environments.

articleTitle: Record-Low-Loss 83 μm2 Effective Area Fiber and Transmission of 40x369 Gb/s Channels over a Trans-Atlantic Submarine Link with 101 km Spans
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present optical fiber with 83 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> effective area and record-low attenuation of 0.1522 dB/km. We conduct experiments with 404 km of fiber in 101 km spans, demonstrating trans-Atlantic system transmission with 369 Gb/s channels. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: NOMA-CoMP for 5G MMW Fiber Wireless Integration Fronthaul System with SFBC
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: NOMA-CoMP based space frequency block coding is firstly proposed and experimentally demonstrated for 28 GHz MMW fiber wireless integration fronthaul system. The end-to-end experiment reveals enhanced cell edge user signal quality and improved spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Asynchronous Successive Interference Canceller for Uplink NOMA-PON
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes a successive interference canceller (SIC) with carrier frequency offset (CFO) compensator for uplink transmission in a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-based coherent PON. We experimentally confirmed SIC’s error-free operation when multiplexing 2 ONUs.

articleTitle: 9 Tb/s Transmission using 29 mW Optical Pump Power per EDFA with 1.24 Tb/s/W Power Efficiency over 15,050 km
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We transmit 143x32.6 GBd 8D-QPSK signal over 15,050 km with EDFAs consuming 29 mW of 980 nm-pump power. We experimentally achieve record power efficiencies from 6.5 to 1.24 Tb/s/W for transmission distances ranging from 6,020 to 15,050 km respectively.

articleTitle: 20.8 Tb/s Transmission over 1200 km Using G654E Fibers, Hybrid Amplification and 400 Gb/s CFP2-DCO Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By using a 400 Gb/s 64Gbaud CFP2-DCO interface, we show error free transmission on fifty-two 75 GHz-spaced spectral positions of a fully loaded 4800 GHz-wide WDM comb over 1200km of G654E fiber with hybrid amplification.

articleTitle: Subwavelength Grating Metamaterial Structures for Integrated Photonics
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on our advances on the use of subwavelength metamaterials for silicon photonic devices, including narrowband filters, antennas, polarization handling, on-chip beam forming and sensing.

articleTitle: Hybrid-Integrated 400G TROSA Module and Its Performance Evaluation Using PAM4 DSP Chip
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on performance evaluation of a hybrid-integrated 4×100G TROSA module using a PAM4 DSP chip. Stable transmission and reception of 106-Gbps/λ PAM4 signals are demonstrated, fully satisfying the 400G-LR4 MSA specifications.

articleTitle: Broadband Polarization Beam Splitters Based on MMI Couplers with Internal Photonic Crystals Fabricated Using 193 nm Photolithography
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonic MMI-coupler-based polarization beam splitter, fabricated using 193 nm photolithography. Measured extinction ratios beyond 30 dB and insertion losses below 3 dB are achieved over a record bandwidth of 111 nm.

articleTitle: Compact K-band Photonic Beamsteerer Assisted with Weakly-Coupled Multi-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical beamsteerer of a photonic integrated circuit employing a weakly-coupled multi-core fiber enables 3-GHz bandwidth in the 24 GHz RF band and a scanning range of 59°, resulting in 16QAM 12 Gbps.

articleTitle: Embedded Orthogonal-Frequency-Division-Multiplexing (OFDM) to Color-Shift-Keying (CSK) Modulation for Laser-Diode based Visible Light Communication (VLC)
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an embedded orthogonal-frequency-division-multiplexing (OFDM) to color-shift-keying (CSK) modulation for laser-diode (LD) based visible-light-communication (VLC) achieving 26.65-Gbit/s with 1.25-m free-space transmission.

articleTitle: Testing TIP Open Source Solutions in Deployed Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Standardization in optical networking enables operators to benefit from using open source components. We investigate quality of transmission of open source hard- and software in the Deutsche Telekom R&D SASER network and optimize the working point.

articleTitle: High-Speed and High Saturation Power Avalanche Photodiode for Coherent Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High-speed/power APDs with novel etched-mesa structure are demonstrated to suppress edge breakdown. With 24μm diameters, they achieve 21GHz bandwidths, 5.5A/W responsivity, and RF saturation power over +5 dBm (10 GHz) under 8mA photocurrent and 0.9V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">br</inf>.

articleTitle: Integrated Silicon Photonics Transmitter in 400GBASE-DR4 QSFP-DD Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the design and characterization of a 4-channel silicon photonics transmitter for 400Gbps DR4 data-center applications. A QSFP-DD transceiver module with this transmitter is demonstrated with reliable performance in real-time operation across 0~70 °C.

articleTitle: High Spatial Channel Count Multicore SDM Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present recent advances in high spatial density multicore fiber amplifiers. The potential operational benefits are presented in comparison to standard erbium-doped fiber amplifiers and the potential cost/power saving benefits discussed.

articleTitle: Enabling Transmission-Aware Adaptive Optical Time Slice Switching in Time-Varying Optical Time Sliced Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An adaptive all-optical time slice switching method based on optical signal envelope perception is studied. Results show high resource utilization can be achieved with fine switching granularity in extreme satellite optical network scenarios.

articleTitle: Hardware Comparison of Feed-Forward Clock Recovery Algorithms for Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Two feed-forward (FF), non-data aided (NDA) digital clock recovery methods in time and frequency domain are discussed and experimentally evaluated with respect to their real-time performance and digital hardware utilization.

articleTitle: Optical Up/Down-conversion of OFDM Wireless Signals based on Ultracompact Silicon Optomechanical Cavities
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical up- and down-conversion of IEEE 802.16 WiMAX OFDM signals using an ultracompact silicon optomechanical crystal cavity operated in the phonon lasing regime at 4 GHz.

articleTitle: C-band 4×200 Gbit/s transmission over 40 km of SSMF with an RF delay-assisted WDM-SSB transmitter
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an RF-delay assisted cost-effective WDM-SSB transmitter using a single DAC per wavelength, and experimentally demonstrate the transmission of net 4×200 Gbit/s DWDM SSB PS-PAM-8 signals over 40 km of SSMF in the C-band.

articleTitle: Enabling dynamic all optical IP off-loading at Tb/s rates in large Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Simulation experiments prove the suitability of VCSEL-based S-BVTs to enable IP off-loading in large MAN topologies. Multi-Tb/s capacity is demonstrated in a real MAN for all primary and secondary multi-level direct paths.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network Soft Demapping for Mitigation of Fiber Nonlinearities and ISI
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical transmission systems suffer from linear and nonlinear impairments induced by components and fibers. As countermeasures, neural network soft-demappers are proposed and benchmarked against combinations of digital back-propagation, Volterra equalizers, noise whitening and soft-output Viterbi-algorithms.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient and Scalable Data Centers with Flexible Bandwidth SiPh All-to-All Fabrics
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents a scalable and energy-efficient flexible-bandwidth optical interconnect architecture for data center networks. The proposed approach leverages silicon photonic reconfigurable all-to-all switch fabrics and a cognitive distributed control plane for optical reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Hybrid EDFA-Raman C+L Band Amplifier through Neural-Network Models
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Experimentally-trained neural network models are used to optimize the 12 Raman pumps of a C+L band hybrid EDFA-Raman amplifier, targeting gains with improved flatness. Gain ripples are decreased from 6.7 to 1.9 dB.

articleTitle: All-Indoor Optical Customer Premises Equipment for Fixed Wireless Access
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an LED-based optical wireless link for fixed wireless access applications, at data rates of 1.5 Gbit/s over 50 m. Transmission between indoor equipment and outdoor access point is possible through metal-coated insulation glass.

articleTitle: Linear Burst-Mode Receivers for DSP-Enabled Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High-dynamic-range and fast-response burst-mode receivers have become a prerequisite for time-division multiplexed passive optical networks (TDM-PON). Recent progress in high-rate burst-mode receiving technologies optimized for linear operation enables upstream equalization or DSP for future PONs.

articleTitle: Weakly-Coupled MCF Direct-Detection OOK Systems Impaired by Laser Phase Noise
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: On-off-keying multicore fiber systems employing different lasers are experimentally investigated. Laser phase noise increases the instantaneous fluctuations of the crosstalk. DFB-based systems may require an additional crosstalk margin of 4 dB relative to ECL-based systems.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Transmitting 270 Gbit/s with PAM-8 in O-band CWDM4 with IM/DD System
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have shown transmission of 270 Gb/s with PAM-8 at each lane of CWDM4 in the O-band up to 2 km. The BER performance in each lane are very similar at 7% HD-FEC limit.

articleTitle: MEC and Fixed Access Networks Synergies
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Both multi-access edge computing and fixed access networks are experiencing tremendous evolutions. We propose here to discuss their synergies, focusing on the needs for industry.

articleTitle: Field Trial of Semi-active WDM System Based on Multi-carrier Pilot-tone for 5G C-RAN Front-haul Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Semi-active WDM system based on multi-carrier pilot-tone with on-line management is proposed. Error-free real-time 24-hour filed-trial transmission of 12-channel 25-Gbps eCPRI signals combined with 12-carrier 512-bps pilot-tone OAM signals over 10 km is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Kernel-Based Learning-Aided Phase Noise Compensation in Dual-Pump Optical Phase Conjugation Coherent System
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We deploy kernel-based time-series prediction to suppress the phase noise induced by small deviations from ideal pump counter-phasing in a dual-pump optical phase conjugation system. We show experimentally 1.5-dB SNR improvement for 16-QAM signals at 4° pump-phase mismatch.

articleTitle: Robust Zero-Change Self-Configuration of the Rectangular Mesh
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an algorithm to self-configure the rectangular mesh [Clements et al., Optica, vol. 3, p. 1460, 2016] using only external sources and detectors. This procedure is robust to hardware imperfections and leads to significant accuracy improvements for optical neural networks on realistic hardware.

articleTitle: Photonics-based tunable 1-50 GHz RF transmitter on silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The paper presents an innovative tunable software-defined RF transmitter based on integrated photonics, able to work in 1-50GHz with very fast tuning. The system has been characterized and verified in a communication scenario

articleTitle: Highly Stabilized Brillouin Random Fiber Laser Based on Self-inscribed Dynamic Fiber Grating
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A self-inscribed dynamic fiber grating as an auto-tracking mode selective element is embedded into a Brillouin random fiber laser, yielding a frequency stabilized Stokes random lasing radiation with highly suppressed modes hoping.

articleTitle: Four-mode waveguide crossing via digitized meta-structure
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A four-mode waveguide crossing with footprint of only 7.5×7.5 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is demonstrated on silicon photonic platform. The device insertion loss is less than 0.85 dB, and the crosstalk is below -18 dB for 1500-1580 nm.

articleTitle: 120 GSa/s BiCMOS Analog Multiplexer Enabling 360 Gbit/s DSCM-PCS-256QAM IM/DD Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Generation of real-valued digital-subcarrier-multiplexed PCS-256QAM is demonstrated using a 120 GSa/s BiCMOS analog multiplexer. A record per-modulation-dimension spectral efficiency of 3 bit/s/Hz is achieved supporting a net data rate of 360 Gbit/s after 10 km IM/DD transmission.

articleTitle: A Latency-Aware Real-Time Video Surveillance Demo: Network Slicing for Improving Public Safety
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the automated deployment of 5G services across a latency-aware, semi-disaggregated, and virtualized metro network. We summarize the key findings in a detailed analysis of end-to-end latency, service setup time, and soft-failure detection time.

articleTitle: LiFi at the heart of future intelligent communications networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Digital wireless technologies have revolutionized our communication habits but still have too limited convergence. Tomorrow, LiFi will accompany, alongside 5G, Fiber & Wi-Fi, exponential data consumption, but will require to redesign a more fluid, secured and intelligent global framework.

articleTitle: Flexible Bandwidth Allocation using OFDM in Mode Forming Optical Access Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Flexible bandwidth allocation using OFDM mode-forming techniques is proposed. 2 channel 6 subcarrier OFDM signals, stabilized by feedback, are transmitted in a conventional GIMMF and each subcarrier is allocated arbitrary to different output port.

articleTitle: GAWBS Noise Correlation Between Cores in Four-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the correlation between GAWBS noise in each core in four-core fiber both experimentally and analytically. The correlation of TR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n,m</inf> modes in each core was found to depend strongly on the order-n and birefringence.

articleTitle: Use of Commercially Available Fiber Optic Components in Emerging Space Laser Communications Applications: Optimizing Performance, Cost, and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper summarizes recent work in developing space laser communications hardware at MIT Lincoln Laboratory, describing how state-of-the-art fiber optic components provide performance and reliability in emerging lasercom system designs.

articleTitle: Programmable, high-speed all-optical nonlinear activation functions for neuromorphic photonics
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate programmable, all-optical nonlinear activation functions, including: rectified linear unit (ReLU), inverse-ReLU and quadratic functions, on a silicon-nitride platform at a remarkable speed of 10 Gbps, enabling real-time processing on all-purpose photonic hardware.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of XOR Separation by On-chip Training a Linear Silicon Photonic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate XOR separation, a classical linearly inseparable problem, by on-chip training linear silicon photonic circuits that we proposed in OFC2020. This device implements nonlinear-projection-linear-separation principle and can perform classification tasks in machine learning.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Silicon Mode Converter Based on a Zigzag-type Metasurface Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-compact silicon waveguide mode converter is proposed and experimentally demonstrated using an all-dielectric metasurface structure with zigzag-type periodic perturbations.

articleTitle: Performance of single-mode transmission over multimode fiber: Offset launch v.s. fundamental mode launch
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study single mode transmission over multimode fiber, and investigate performance difference when the launch is offset patch cord versus center launch. BER performance and optical eye diagram plots with 10GBASE LRM 10GBASE-LR transceivers are presented.

articleTitle: High Precision Indoor Robot Localization Using VLC Enabled Smart Lighting
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high precision visible light communication (VLC)-based mobile robot positioning demonstration is proposed<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>. Based on our built experiment platform, the positioning accuracy is within 2cm.

articleTitle: High Speed VCSEL: Technology and Applications - Tutorial
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. They report on recent advances in vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs). Modern VCSELs enable multiple applications in sensing and in data communication, where they operate at speeds of up to 224Gb/s per single chip.

articleTitle: Wavelength Resources Management and Switching of Active Entanglement Distribution Circuits in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We provide a formal definition of the entangled wavelength-pairs allocation problem using PDDL paired with a Fast-Forward planner and switching algorithm to optimize the resources of entanglement distribution circuits in optical networks.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Spatial Multiplexing by Digital Beamforming in 5G Fiber-Wireless Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multiple data streams sharing the same time-frequency resource block through digital beamforming technique are received at different angles of arrival by a 1-by-4 antenna array and decoded simultaneously in 5G fiber-wireless integrated access network.

articleTitle: A Sum-Difference Microring Filter for Lossless Bandwidth Tuning
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a general variable-bandwidth filter for lossless tuning based on the sum-difference microring filter architecture. We demonstrate a 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order filter in SOI, achieving ~5 folds increase in bandwidth without extra insertion loss or degradation in filter shape.

articleTitle: Integrated Dual-DFB Laser Chip-based PAM-4 Photonic-Wireless Transmission in W-band
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate lens-free photonic-wireless transmission in the W-band using a monolithically integrated dual-DFB laser, which is injection-locked by a frequency comb to generate two 90-GHz-spacing phase-stabilized carriers and modulated with a 40-Gbit/s PAM-4 signal.

articleTitle: Evaluation of an Autonomous Digital Pre-distortion Scheme for Optical Multiband Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a DSP scheme that autonomously adapts the design of Volterra and memory polynomial digital pre-distortion filters in S+C+L-band transmission. We validate it with a DP-32QAM signal at 64 GBd over 40-km of SSMF.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Broadband Two-Mode Transverse-Electric Multiplexer in SOI platform
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an ultra-broadband two-mode (de) multiplexer using a tapered asymmetric directional coupler (ADC). Measurements exhibit insertion loss less than 1.2 dB and crosstalk better than 16 dB covering 1260-1360 nm and 1500-1600 nm.

articleTitle: 28-GHz mmWave Hybrid Beamforming System Integrated with a 64-Element Glass Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A multi-Gb/s 28-GHz mmWave hybrid-beamforming system integrated with a 64element antenna array fabricated on a Corning-glass-substrate is demonstrated. DSP-based adaptive-hybrid-algorithms are utilized to achieve both electronic beam-steering and multi-user operation with >23-dB inter-user interference suppression.

articleTitle: Accelerating Parallel Sort on Tightly-Coupled FPGAs enabled by Onboard Si-Photonics Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We illustrate a case for a tightly-coupled lightweight fully-connected inter-FPGA optical network with Si-photonics transceivers. Counting sort of in-memory column-oriented data using eight custom FPGA cards can be 5.3 times faster than that with eight CPU-servers.

articleTitle: Getting to femtojoule optics – what physics and what technology?
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical physics and well-chosen intimately-integrated devices allow dense, low-energy communications if we also use optical parallelism and timing precision to eliminate most receiver, time-multiplexing and timing circuits that otherwise dissipate most of the energy.

articleTitle: Multi-layer Transport Network Slicing with Hard and Soft Isolation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We validate the deployment of isolated transport network slices in IP over DWDM network. To this end, an isolated transport network slice is deployed using multi-layer isolation mechanisms based on OpenConfig and ONF Transport API.

articleTitle: Tunable DBR Laser with Integrated Optical Isolator
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Integration of a tunable DBR laser with an optical isolator in a polymer platform achieves 38 dB isolation over 17 nm tuning range and 5.6 mW output power. Device size is 2 x 6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Multi-Chiplet System Architecture With Shared Uniform Access Memory Based on Board-Level Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new multi-chiplet system architecture based on shared uniform memory access and on-board optical interconnects. System-level simulation results demonstrate that such systems offer improved execution times and energy efficiency over conventional computing architectures.

articleTitle: Multi-channel quantum communication receiver made from waveguide-integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a fiber-coupled multi-channel waveguide-integrated superconducting single-photon detector array for fast, efficient and highly parallelized counting with below 65 ps timing accuracy for high-rate quantum key distribution implementations at telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: Digital Compensation of Residual Pump Dithering in Optical Phase Conjugation of High-Order QAM
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a new two-stage digital scheme to suppress the phase distortion due to residual pump dithering in the dual-pump fibre-based optical phase conjugation of high-order (64/256) QAM signals. We show more than 5-dB SNR improvement relative to conventional phase-noise compensation at high pump-phase mismatch levels.

articleTitle: Experimental Comparison of Uniform and Probabilistically Shaped PAM-8 for IMDD System at Transmission Rates Beyond 200 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have experimentally shown that probabilistically shaped PAM-8 improves receiver sensitivity by more than 1 dB compared with regular PAM-8 for data rates beyond 200 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic MZM Architectures for 200G per Lambda IM/DD Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review design considerations for silicon photonic single-segment and multi-segment Mach-Zehnder modulators for net 200 Gbit/s/lane intensity modulation direct detection applications. We consider constraints from both the technology and future standards.

articleTitle: LDPC Coded PAM-4/8 Transmission in Fiber-FSO Link Using Unipolar Probability Distribution and Pre-distortion
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated LDPC coded PAM transmission with unipolar distribution and pre-distortion in a fiber-FSO hybrid link with the parity bits inserted in the LSB. Different schemes are experimentally compared with up to 2.1-dB sensitivity improvement.

articleTitle: Interpretable and visualized SHAP-based equalizer with feature selection in IMDD system
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We firstly leveraged the SHAP-based method to visualize and analyze trained equalizers in IMDD-based short-reach system and manifested in bandwidth-limitation PAM-4 system. As a result, half of the features are reduced without deteriorating system performance.

articleTitle: 32dB of Optical Budget with DSP-free real time experimentation up to 50Gbit/s NRZ using O-band DFB-EAM and SOA-PIN for Higher Speed PONs
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We achieve 32.3dB of optical budget and 45km reach transmission in real time with an O-band EAM-DFB and SOA-PIN for 50Gbit/s NRZ standards. A DSP-free transmission was demonstrated with a semi-cooled transmitter.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of phase-sensitive OTDR with adaptive probe-pulse modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With deep learning, the restoration of phase-sensitive OTDR impulse response is achieved with double rectangular test pulses, thereafter optimal probe-pulse is designed to suppress interference fading at designated zone.

articleTitle: Impact of Chromatic Dispersion in Discrete Raman Amplifiers on Coherent Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The impact of chromatic dispersion in discrete Raman amplifiers on coherent transmission systems was investigated. Systems with positive dispersion gain fibre show a SNR improvement of ~1.8 dB for 23-GBaud DP-QPSK signals transmitted over >1800km.

articleTitle: Digital Orthogonal Filtering-Enabled Synchronous Transmissions of I/Q Waveforms and Control Words for Bandwidth-Efficient and Low-Complexity Mobile Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate digital orthogonal filtering-enabled synchronous transmissions of 24 20MHz LTE signals and CWs, achieving an EVM of 3.1% and a SNR of 31.4dB for I/Q waveforms and CWs, respectively, over a 6km SSMF.

articleTitle: All-optical switching with graphene-loaded plasmonic waveguides in the femtojoule and femtosecond range
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Graphene’s ultrafast carrier response enables ultrafast device operation, but its thinness makes graphene devices large and energy consuming. Introducing plasmonic nanostructures overcomes this problem and makes it possible to develop ultrafast, energy-efficient all-optical switches.

articleTitle: Estimation of Core-Cladding Concentricity Error From GAWBS Noise Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: CCCE in a 60-km fiber is estimated from its GAWBS noise spectrum by comparing the TR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1m</inf> modes with the R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0m</inf> modes. The estimated CCCE value 0.73 μm is consistent with conventional measurements of 0.6–0.8 μm.

articleTitle: Recess-type waveguide integrated germanium on silicon avalanche photodiode
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a recess-type Ge on Si WGAPD receiver with 106Gb/s PAM4 overload >0dBm and unstressed/stressed sensitivities of -18.9/18dBm, which provides about 19dB dynamic range for 100Gb/s per lane applications.

articleTitle: Scalable 1×N switch via on-chip tunable metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An integrated 1×N switch is proposed and experimentally demonstrated via tunable silicon photonic metasurface which has an insertion loss of 3 dB and extinction ratio of 5 dB in the C band.

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Bus-Coupled Spiral-Ring Resonator for Dual-Mode Locking Temperature Stabilization
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> bus-coupled spiral-ring dual-mode resonator reference cavity, with high extinction ratios for both TE and TM modes, is demonstrated for temperature stabilization. The temperature is stabilized within ± 60 μK variation over 16 hours.

articleTitle: Autonomous Security Management in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The paper describes the Optical Security Manager module and focuses on the role of Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Issues related to accuracy, run-time complexity and interpretability of ML outputs are described and coping strategies outlined.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Nonlinearity Compensation for Short-Reach IM/DD Systems using PAM
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the performance of non-regular PAM8 constellations and introduce a novel non-uniformly quantized equalizer to improve nonlinearity compensation in 70 GBd PAM8 back-to-back and 1 km SSMF transmission without additional complexity.

articleTitle: Microresonator Brillouin Laser Gyroscope with Earth-Rotation-Rate Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical gyroscopes are widely used for precision navigation and there has been growing interest in the possibility of integrated optical gyroscopes. In this talk, we report a chip-based Brillouin laser gyroscope with Earth-rotation-rate sensitivity.

articleTitle: Ultra-Long-Haul WDM Transmission in a Reduced InterModal Interference NANF Hollow-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report new transmission distance records through hollow-core NANF with reduced inter-modal interference. We recirculated 41xPM-QPSK C-band channels @32GBaud up to 2070km with average GMI 3.64 bits/symb. For select channels we reached beyond 5000km.

articleTitle: Calibration-Free Mach-Zehnder Silicon-Photonic Switch
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose calibration-free Mach-Zehnder silicon-photonic-switch networks based on new 2×2 Mach-Zehnder switches with ultralow random phase errors (~0.02π rad). The demonstrated 4×4 Benes switch has <−20 dB crosstalk in the C-band.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact and broadband 3-dB power splitter based on subwavelength grating at 2-μm
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 3-dB power splitter based on subwavelength grating waveguides. The devices footprint is only 3 μm ×2 μm. The insertion loss is < 0.3 dB and the bandwidth exceeds 55 nm at 2-μm waveband.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Cable Employing 200 µm-Coated Multicore Fibers for High Density Wiring in Datacom
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical fiber cable employing 200 µm coated 4-core fibers was fabricated and confirmed to satisfy the characteristics required for conventional cables. 200 µm coating multicore fibers are promising candidates for ultra-high density cables.

articleTitle: 32 Tbit/s Transmission over 1400 km Using Power Allocation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transmission of C-band 40×800 Gbit/s signals using 125 Gbaud PCS-64QAM is demonstrated by performing power allocation optimization at the input of 3 OMSs along a 15-span link (>20 dB loss each) with EDFA-only amplification.

articleTitle: Inter-Band Interference Cancellation Based on Independent Component Analysis for 200Gb/s/λ Non-Orthogonal m-CAP NGFI-II Data Transmission in 5G Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated 200Gb/s/λ mobile fronthaul NGFI-II data transmission based on non-orthogonal-m-CAP system. A novel inter-band interference cancellation method based on independent component analysis is proposed to achieve 13% SE improvement.

articleTitle: Doubling the Spectral Efficiency with EVM as the Objective Function for Training Neural Networks in Non-Orthogonal Visible Light Communications Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, that neural network detector performance can be enhanced by using EVM as the objective loss function. This method allows bandwidth compression up to 50% in non-orthogonal VLC systems.

articleTitle: Record High Power Single-mode Operation and Beam Steering of VCSEL-Integrated Amplifier/Beam Scanner
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate single-mode surface-grating VCSEL-integrated amplifier/beam scanner. We obtained the record single-mode output-power over 3W under pulsed operations. A continuous fan-beam steering of 5° and 70 resolution points are achieved.

articleTitle: Long-Haul WDM/SDM Transmission over Coupled 4-Core Fiber with Coupled 4-Core EDFA and Its MDL Characteristics Estimation
