publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated WDM/SDM transmission of 32-Gbaud PDM-QPSK over coupled 4-core fibers and EDFAs with error-free after FEC for up to 2400 km. We estimated that rms MDL of 1.1 dB per loop was limiting performance.

articleTitle: >25 Gbit/s LiFi with Laser Based SMD White Light Source
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed LiFi (Light Fidelity) communication system deploying ultra-high brightness laser-based white light illumination sources in a surface mount device (SMD) package platform. The multi functionality sources provide 1000 lm of white light output with a brightness of 1000 cd/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and data transmission rates beyond 20 Gbit/s from dual blue laser integrated SMD, and 500 lm of white light output with a brightness of 1000 cd/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and data transmission rates beyond 25 Gbit/s from dual color of blue and infrared (IR) laser integrated SMD.

articleTitle: Dynamic auto-negotiation with real-time transponders in software defined optical networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We designed a transponder with dynamic auto-negotiation allowing fast detection of performance degradation and reconfiguration. We implemented a proof-of-concept using a commercial transponder, FPGA, and Raspberry Pi. We assessed the performance in terms of latency.

articleTitle: Telemetry Solutions in Disaggregated Optical Networks: an Experimental View
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Effective telemetry streaming for disaggregated whitebox is discussed, focusing on implementation issues. A novel gRPC peer-to-peer telemetry for next-generation AI-equipped xPonders is proposed and evaluated in a disaggregated testbed exploiting OpenConfig and OpenROADM models.

articleTitle: Advanced Beam Shaping for Enhanced Underwater Wireless Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A diffraction-based optical launching unit was demonstrated to improve the propagating efficiency of the laser beam in the lossy and scattering medium, leading to significant enhancement on the underwater transmission quality over 15m at 100Mbps. © 2021

articleTitle: Power-saving Aware Optical Path Assignment for over-Peta-bit-throughput SDM Photonic Node
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel optical path assignment algorithm that reduces the power consumption of MC-EDFAs in SDM photonic nodes. We simulate efficient path assignment and experimentally demonstrate its power-saving relative to the conventional algorithm.

articleTitle: 20 Gb/s WDM Optical RAM Row Architecture based on four Monolithic Integrated InP Memory Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A complete 4-bit WDM-enabled all-optical RAM Row architecture with 20 Gb/s memory-bus throughput is experimentally presented for the first time, using four 5Gb/s monolithic InP Flip-Flops and a multi-wavelength Random Access and Column Selector peripheral circuit.

articleTitle: Wavelength Selective Switch Components with High Spectral Resolution and Compactness
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review the wavelength selective switch (WSS) for ultra-broadband transmission and spatial division multiplexing. We also discuss and present experimental results of WSS components with high spectral resolution and compactness.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Extremes of SNR Time Series Data Using Extreme Value Statistics
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the suitability of extreme value statistics for the analysis of the extreme values of SNR time series data from a deployed network. Underlying theory, potential use cases and practical considerations are discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel Linearization Method for Optical Transmitters Based on Directly-Modulated Lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new practical method to correct the non-linearity of directly-modulated lasers is presented and an experimental proof-of-principle demonstration is reported. High-quality NRZ transmission at 16 Gb/s is achieved using a VCSEL specified for 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: DRL-Based Channel and Latency Aware Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Multi-User Millimeter-Wave RAN
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A DRL-based uplink resource allocation algorithm with channel condition and latency awareness is demonstrated for multi-user RAN. The algorithm is verified experimentally with dynamic RoF-mmWave channels, achieving 19% reward improvement compared to conventional scheduling schemes.

articleTitle: Blade Abstraction Interface for Diverse Blade Integration and Unified Control of Disaggregate/Legacy ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a blade abstraction interface (BAI) for unifying the blade control and easing the use of diverse blades in heterogeneous ROADMs, also demonstrate the integration of disaggregate, legacy ROADMs and a hybrid node in disaster recovery.

articleTitle: Recent Breakthroughs in Hollow Core Fiber Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The performance of Hollow Core Fibers has improved dramatically over the last 6 years. We report progress of the most successful design, Nested Antiresonant Nodeless Fiber, with losses of 0.28 dB/km.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 100Gbit/s Real-Time Ultra High Definition Video Transmission Over Free Space Optical Communication Links
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The real-time FSO transmission of 100Gbps 4K-UHD video streams over 2.1km horizontal atmospheric link is successfully demonstrated. Results show that 100Gbps 4K-UHD video can be transmitted with negligible errors in 1000 seconds.

articleTitle: Low latency transmission over 400 m Hollow-Core-Fiber Cable at 100G PAM-4 per wavelength
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present experiments for attenuation, dispersion, and latency characterization of commercially available Hollow Core Fiber cable. We investigate the spectral windows for reliable transmission of 100 Gbps per wavelength using pulse amplitude modulation schemes.

articleTitle: In-Band OSNR Estimation from Transponder Telemetry using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ensemble learning using transponder telemetry to minimize the maximum absolute error (MAE) of the OSNR monitoring is studied. Trained model reduces the MAE to 2.08 dB which is 10 dB smaller than commercial DSP estimates.

articleTitle: High Radix SOA-Based Lossless Optical Switch Prototyping for 25 GBaud PAM4 Transmission in Modern Intra-datacenter Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In a development towards high-radix datacenter networks, we demonstrate 25 GBaud PAM4 transmission through a three-stage 8 × 8 SOA-based lossless optical switch, implemented as a monolithic photonic integrated circuit in indium phosphide.

articleTitle: Dual M-Layers Avalanche Photodiodes with Extremely Wide Dynamic Ranges and Ultra-High Bandwidth-Responsivity Product Performances in FMCW Lidar Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dual multiplication-layers APDs with large bandwidth-responsivity product (460GHz-A/W), saturation-current (>10mA), and IF-power (+4.5dBm) are demonstrated in self-heterodyne FWCW lidar systems with ~285% modulation depths. Constructed images show 9.5dB larger SNRs than that of p-i-n PD.

articleTitle: Measurement of Propagation Constants of Graded Index Multi-mode Fiber Using Rayleigh Backscattered Light
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We measure the distributed differential group delay and effective refractive index difference between all 9 mode groups of a graded index multi-mode fiber using optical frequency domain reflectometry by cross correlating Raleigh backscatter signals.

articleTitle: Wideband PPLN-based optical parametric amplifiers for scalable optical transport network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reviews the wideband optical parametric amplifiers based on periodically poled LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (PPLN) waveguides for scalable optical transport network. The achievable bandwidth over 10 THz is promising to offset capacity crunch in today’s network.

articleTitle: Crosstalk Statistical Distributions in Multicore Fibers Under Different Deployment Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Crosstalk statistical distributions of multicore fiber are studied theoretically and experimentally. It is shown that a crosstalk distribution can be characterized with different types of perturbations to yield the same result.

articleTitle: LiFi is Ready for Mainstream
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Mainstream LiFi is just on the horizon. Using light instead of radio waves to send and receive data, LiFi’s security, safety and bandwidth advantages make it the right solution at the right time.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Silicon-Photonics WDM NFT Soliton Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a silicon-photonics transmitter capable of modulating and optically merging solitons with different frequency and time spacing based on the nonlinear Fourier-transform, offloading electronics. Two soliton channels successfully transmit up to 5000 km.

articleTitle: Parallel Phase Stabilization of 45 Single-Mode Fiber Inputs Feeding a Mode Multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous phase stabilization of 45 parallel input spatial channels to a mode multiplexer. The phase errors for all output modes are calculated using digital holography and fed back to parallel piezo-based fiber stretchers.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth and low thermal tuning power thermally tuned multi-channel interference widely tunable semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The high-performance thermally tuned multi-channel interference widely tunable semiconductor laser was demonstrated for the first time, achieving tuning range of more than 60nm, SMSRs of up to 56dB and Lorentzian linewidth of less than 100kHz.

articleTitle: Coherent Homodyne Synaptic Interconnect with Sign- and Weight-Tunable Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally investigate a synaptic interconnect with low-complexity emitter and coherent receiver. Phase tuning of the LO enables the signed multiplication of the detected signal, which is demonstrated for 130-ps spikes at 1-GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Scalable for Cloud-native Transport SDN Controller Using GNPy and Machine Learning techniques for QoT estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This demo shows a cloud-native SDN controller that can estimate end-to-end QoT using both analytical (GNPy) and machine learning algorithms on WDM systems. This transport SDN controller is able to scale horizontally using custom metrics.

articleTitle: Traffic Rate Matrix Decomposition Based Conflict Free Scheduling for a Fast Optical Switching Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a traffic rate matrix decomposition (TRMD) based conflict free scheduling for a fast optical switching network and show that TRMD outperforms a flow control protocol with <10µs latency and >92% throughput at load of 1.

articleTitle: System Optimization of High-efficiency 400 Gb/s PAM4 Silicon Photonics Transmitter for Data Center Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high-efficiency PAM4 silicon photonics transmitter optimized through end-to-end system modeling for applications up to 10km on four-channel CWDM4 grid. Our measurements show a close agreement with simulations meeting 400G-FR4 requirements with 1.7Vppd.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Slice Fault Monitoring and Handling for Converged Optical-Wireless Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We designed and experimentally demonstrate a RAN slice management system which supports fault monitoring and handling. The system can not only quickly build RAN slices that meet user needs, but also can automatically and timely complete fault handling and service recovery when RAN slice resources fail.

articleTitle: Reduced Impact of Frequency Dithering on the Performance of High-Order Modulation Format Phase Conjugation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We address the primary degradations in optical phase conjugation devices, reducing the implementation penalty to below 0.2dB and enabling, for the first time, performance improvement in a 400-km long probabilistically shaped 256-QAM transmission system.

articleTitle: Entangled Sensor Networks Empowered by Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a reconfigurable radio-frequency photonic sensor network based on continuous-variable multipartite entanglement. We further show that the entangled sensor network can be trained to undertake quantum-enhanced data classification tasks.

articleTitle: Mode Division Multiplexing on Standard 50/125 µm Multi Mode Fiber using Photonic Lanterns
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, direct detection MIMO free mode division multiplexing over standard multi mode fibers, is demonstrated using photonic lantern mode multiplexers. Stable transmission performance is demonstrated over 1.6 km independent of input polarization.

articleTitle: Demonstration of ML-aided Impairment-aware L0 Path Computation in Fully Disaggregated Multi-vendor Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an online impairment-aware L0 path computation capability leveraging a machine learning model to recommend the most appropriate path and optical parameters combination for a connectivity service request in the fully disaggregated multi-vendor optical transport network.

articleTitle: Estimating nonlinear phase shift in a multi-span fiber-optic link using a coherent transceiver
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique to measure the nonlinear phase shifts of multi-span fiber optic links with a polarization-multiplexed coherent transceiver based on cross-phase modulation between two orthogonally polarized subcarrier tones.

articleTitle: High-Power, Low-Noise, and High-Speed 850 nm VCSEL Arrays with for Optical Wireless Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 850nm VCSEL arrays (7x7) using Zn-diffusion/Oxide-relief apertures have been demonstrated. It exhibits high CW power (190 mW), dampening E-O frequency response, and wide 3-dB E-O bandwidths (13 GHz). 25Gbit/sec error-free transmission has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Meeting industrial needs with optical fiber sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical Fiber Sensor technology has shown major developments recently, especially in uses across a range of different industrial measurement situations. Several illustrative applications are considered, with the benefits and outcomes of their use reviewed.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s Intra-Chip Compact Electro-Optical Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a digital-to-optical-to-digital link operating at 10 Gb/s with 2.4 pJ/b below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER enabled by zero-change CMOS macros. All necessary electronic-photonic circuits are contained within 0.015 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of silicon area.

articleTitle: Effective Linewidth Reduction in Self-Homodyne Coherent Reception Enabled by stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We significantly narrow the effective linewidth in a coherent optical link from 75 kHz to ~ 2 kHz using SBS-based optical carrier recovery. Experiment results show that the phase recovery window length can be enlarged by over 100x with less than 0.5 dB Q<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> penalty.

articleTitle: Static Weight Detection and Localization on Aerial Fiber Cables using Distributed Acoustic Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated for the first time to our knowledge, the detection and localization of a static weight on an aerial cable by using frequency domain decomposition analysis of ambient vibrations detected by a φ-DAS system.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Probabilistic Constellation Shaping for Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, continuous-variable quantum key distribution using probabilistically-shaped 1024-QAM and true local oscillator, achieving 38.3Mb/s secret key rate over 9.5km, averaged over the transmission time of 100 blocks.

articleTitle: 4.36 Tbit/s Silicon Chip-to-Chip Transmission via Few-Mode Fiber (FMF) using 2D Sub-wavelength Grating Couplers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed silicon chip-to-chip few-mode-fiber (FMF) transmission via 2D sub-wavelength grating-couplers. The design and characterization of the proposed silicon device are discussed. A total FMF transmission capacity of 4.36 Tbit/s is achieved.

articleTitle: Joint Multi-Eigenvalue Demodulation Using Complex Moment-based Eigenvalue Solver and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a joint demodulation scheme using a parallel eigenvalue solver and ANN. The proposed scheme is demonstrated experimentally by 2000-km fiber transmission with < 2-dB OSNR penalty compared with conventional QZ method.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Electro-Optically Modulated Kerr Soliton Comb to a Chip-Scale Mode-Locked Laser PIC via Harmonic Injection Locking
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an optical frequency division technique to transfer the timing stability of a stabilized Kerr Microresonator Soliton Frequency Comb (~305 GHz repetition rate) to a chip-scaled mode-locked laser (~10 GHz repetition rate).

articleTitle: Silicon Nitride Band Splitter Based on Multimode Bragg Gratings
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon nitride multimode Bragg grating as a C/L diplexer for single-fiber bidirectional communications. The device was fabricated using optical lithography and achieved a channel isolation greater than 20 dB.

articleTitle: Real-Time Control Plane Operations for gOSNR QoT Estimation through OSNR Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze an optical control plane algorithm designed to operate in real-time to improve generalized-optical signal-to-noise ratio (gOSNR) quality-of-transmission-estimation (QoT-E), based on OSNR monitoring. We report QoT-E performance improvements of up to 1 dB.

articleTitle: Quantization Noise Suppression with Noise-shaping Technique in DMT-modulated IM/DD Optical Interconnects utilizing Low-resolution DAC
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Beyond 100 Gb/s 16/32QAM DMT signal transmitting over 2-km SMF enabled by DAC with 4-bit quantization resolution in IM/DD system is experimentally demonstrated. By utilizing the noise-shaping technique, the system with 4-bit quantization presents the same performance as the conventional IM/DD system with quantization resolution of 8-bit at BER of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Photonics for Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Neuromorphic photonics creates processors 1000× faster than electronics while consuming less energy. We will discuss the role of neuromorphic photonics in optical communications, review existing approaches, and outline the required technologies to evolve this field.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Hierarchical Subcarrier Rate and Distribution Matching for up to 1.032 Tb/s or 262144-QAM
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel hierarchical subcarrier rate and distribution matching has been implemented in an FPGA at 1.032 Tb/s. The implemented subsystem achieves seamless data flow among subcarriers at a resolution < 0.01 bit per channel use.

articleTitle: Towards Dynamic Network Reconfigurations for Flexible Optical Network Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a network reconfiguration heuristic, incorporating provisioning, upgrading, and rerouting of lightpaths for multi-period planning. Using the same physical network infrastructure, we achieve up to 33% increase in network throughput compared to the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: High Baud Rate Modulation: Applications for Next-Generation Backbone Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 95 GBaud transponders, equipped with probabilistic shaping and advanced FEC, improve backbone networks by reducing power and increasing spectral efficiency. We review network expectations and observations for this class of transponder.

articleTitle: 4-channel E-band data transmission over 160 km of SMF-28 using a bismuth-doped fibre amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate transmission of four 10 Gbit/s NRZ channels in the E-band over 160 km of SMF-28 using a bismuth-doped fibre amplifier with 32 dB maximum gain and 5 dB minimum NF.

articleTitle: High-performance polarization-handling devices on silicon
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recent progresses for high-performance polarization-handling components on silicon are reported, including polarization-selective silicon photonic devices as well as photonic devices working with dual polarizations, which are very useful for various optical systems.

articleTitle: 1,728-Fiber Cable with 12-Fiber Ribbons Comprising 160-µm Coating Fiber with 80-µm Cladding
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The availability of a 160-µm fiber with 80-µm cladding is demonstrated through the performance of a 1,728-fiber cable with 12-fiber ribbons, fusion-splicing loss of ribbonized fiber, and loss of MPO connection to a 125-µm-cladding fiber.

articleTitle: Fabrication-Tolerant Nitride Lattice Filter for CWDM
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-nitride passive 2-channel cascaded lattice filter with <1.7nm (6σ) wavelength variation across four CMOS wafers by implementing fabrication insensitive MZI design.

Author Keywords: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Arbitrary Dispersion Compensation of Periodic Waveforms using On-chip Discrete Phase Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a discrete phase filter design suitable for arbitrary dispersion compensation of periodic waveforms using waveguide Bragg gratings in silicon. Higher-order dispersion compensation (equivalent to 5,000 km long optical fiber) of a 40-GHz picosecond pulse train is experimentally demonstrated using mm-long phase filters.

articleTitle: Squeezing Out the Achievable Information Rate From Coherent QAM Systems Through Amplitude Modulation of CPE-Pilots
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to perform amplitude modulation over DSP pilots commonly employed for carrier-phase estimation, utilizing the extra information rate to carry additional FEC overhead. For moderate pilot overheads of 3-6%, we demonstrate SNR gains in the range of 0.6-1.7dB.

articleTitle: 115-Gbps/λ Fiber/FSO Transmission with Supervised and Semi-supervised Nonlinearity Correction Using Lasso
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We leverage supervised/semi-supervised methods and Lasso to perform nonlinearity compensations in a fiber/FSO system. A proof-of-concept experiment has demonstrated up to 3.1dB power-margin improvement and significantly reduced pilot symbol ratio.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Switch-Enabled Server Regrouping Using Bandwidth Steering for Distributed Deep Learning Training
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate SiP switch-enabled server regrouping using bandwidth steering for performance improvement in distributed deep learning training in a Fat-tree testbed. Our proposed SiP switch control scheme enables scaling to large-scale datacenter and HPC systems.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic Interrogator with On-Chip References
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a silicon integrated photonic interrogator with on-chip wavelength and temperature referencing for absolute measurements. We demonstrate fiber Bragg grating interrogation with ±1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>C temperature accuracy without thermo-electric coolers.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Extensible Disaggregated NE Management based on a SONiC-compliant Software-Agent Optical OpenConfig/gNMI Telemetry Go Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The proof-of-concept of a robust and extensible disaggregated network element management using a SONiC-compliant Go-based software agent implementation of OpenConfig gNMI optical streaming telemetry, is demonstrated and evaluated in a multivendor testbed.

articleTitle: 320Gb/s Nyquist-shaped Twin SSB 16-QAM Signal Transmission over 80km SSMF with a Silicon IQ Modulator
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ultrahigh speed metro-haul optical transmission of twin SSB 16-QAM signal with a Silicon IQ modulator. A 320Gb/s data rate over 80km SSMF is achieved with a BER below the 20% SD-FEC threshold.

articleTitle: A Novel low-latency DBA for Virtualised PON implemented through P4 In-Network Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel dual-DBA allocation, with a fast P4-enabled scheduler to provide low latency upstream grant allocations. We show latency reduction of 37% and 43%, respectively, compared to standard and virtual PONs.

articleTitle: Wideband Laser Linewidth Reduction Using a Hybrid Integrated Phase Noise Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The first nanophotonic phase noise filter is demonstrated that reduces laser linewidth from 2.55 MHz to 4 kHz and from 200 kHz to 320 Hz. The electronic and pho-tonic chips occupy 3 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of area. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Fast and Uniform Optically-Switched Data Centre Networks Enabled by Amplitude Caching
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose amplitude caching to optically equalise burst mode traffic without delay stages. Through a fast, optically-switched system prototype, we demonstrate burst-mode penalties can be mitigated to within 0.4 dB at the KR4 HD-FEC level.

articleTitle: Broadband Dynamic Injection-Locking Performance of Fabry-Perot LD and Its Application to Coherent Homodyne Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe the broadband injection-locking performance of a Fabry-Perot LD (FP-LD) whose dynamic locking bandwidth can be greatly extended to 28.8 GHz with a low Q-value FP-LD. Application to 256 QAM demodulation is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Communication in the Age of AI
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: AI is software that writes software, and it is fed by data. AI is the most powerful force of our time and it profoundly changes the way computers are built and connected.

articleTitle: MOSCAP Ring Modulator with 1.5 µm Radius, 8.5 THz FSR and 30 GHz/V Shift Efficiency in a 45 nm SOI CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the smallest microring modulator to date, with 1.5 µm radius, record 8.5 THz FSR and 30 GHz/V O-band shift efficiency, using a MOSCAP structure in a new 45 nm monolithic CMOS electronic-photonic process (45CLO). It could enable massively-parallel optical links with low energy and high bandwidth density.

articleTitle: Scalable and Reconfigurable True Time Delay Line Based on High Performance Switches
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A scalable and reconfigurable optical true time delay line consisting of high performance MZI switch driving by a parallel graphene heater easily scaled to M bit with a slight increase in dimensions was proposed. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: AlGaInAs MQW Laser Regrowth on Heterogenerous InP-on-SOI: Performance for Different Silicon Cavity Designs
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Vertical p-i-n lasers integrated by wafer-bonding and regrowth on a heterogeneous InP-on-SOI wafer are presented. We demonstrate for the first time lasers based on regrown III-V active regions efficiently coupled to Si-photonic DBR cavities.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 2-Gbit/s Free-Space Optical Communications Through Dynamic Aerosol and Dynamic Water Interface using Orbital-Angular-Momentum Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 2-Gbit/s OAM-multiplexed free-space optical communications through dynamic aerosol and dynamic water interface. We observe a ~2-dB power penalty at the 7% FEC limit for both OAM -1 and +2 channels.

articleTitle: SOA-Based Scintillation-Suppressed MLPolSK Detection in FSO Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes SOA-Based scintillation-suppressed MLPolSK detection in FSO communications. Polarization-independent SOA is applied to mitigate the scintillation effect, and polarization-dependent SOA is used to transform SOPs into intensity. 8LPolSK was effectively detected in experiment.

articleTitle: Autonomous Physical Layer Characterization in Cognitive Optical Line Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a procedure to autonomously characterize the optical line system physical layer, span-by-span, using in-line OTDRs and OCMs. This procedure has been experimentally validated, showing a clear correlation between the experimental outcomes and emulations.

articleTitle: Active Compensation of Nonlinear Effects in Silicon Photonic Microring Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a technique for automated active compensation of nonlinear effects in silicon photonic coupled microring resonator filters. Transmission performances of 200 Gbit/s DP 16-QAM signals up to 20 dBm are evaluated.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Photonic Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Neuromorphic photonics exploit optical device physics for neuron models, and optical interconnects for distributed, parallel, and analog processing for high-bandwidth, low-latency and low switching energy applications in artificial intelligence and neuromorphic computing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of AI-Assisted Intent-Based Traffic Grooming in 5G Optical Access Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an Al-assisted intent-based traffic grooming scheme in 5G optical access network. The experimental results show scheme achieves autonomous decision-making for service assurance and efficiently optimizes network performance by AI-assisted intent-based traffic grooming.

articleTitle: Monolithic Integration of III-V/Si Hybrid MOS Optical Phase Shifter and InGaAs Membrane Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present proof-of-concept monolithic integration of III-V/Si hybrid MOS optical phase shifter and InGaAs membrane photodetector for Si programmable photonic integrated circuits. We demonstrated responsivity of > 1.0 A/W at O-band owing to avalanche amplification.

articleTitle: RSE-based optical camera communication in underwater scenery with bubble degradation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical camera communication (OCC) is a promising technique. We demonstrated a rolling-shutter-based OCC in the underwater bubble scenario with 7.2 kbit/s data rate by employing the proposed de-bubble algorithm and binary fringe correction.

articleTitle: Novel Scalable and Reconfigurable Optical Fronthaul Network for Converged Radio Frequency and Data Services Using Silicon Photonic Switching
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a converged optical fronthaul network for RF and data services with scalable silicon photonic switching. A 1.5dB power penalty at a 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER and over 40dB RF dynamic range are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Manhole locating technique using distributed vibration sensing and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A field trial of manhole locating technique using optical-sensing was conducted to improve the efficiency of facility inspections. Machine-learning was applied for automatic location estimation and a high precision of over 90 % was achieved.

articleTitle: Z-Score Averaging Neural Network and Background Content Removal for High Performance Rolling Shutter based Optical Camera Communication (OCC)
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate using Z-score averaging neural-network (Z-NN) and background-content-removal (BCR) to mitigate the inter-symbol-interference (ISI) in camera-communication (OCC). 950-bit/s over 3-m free-space transmission is achieved.

articleTitle: Enabling S-C-L-Band Systems with Standard C-Band Modulator and Coherent Receiver using Nonlinear Predistortion
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate S-band reception of 64-GBd PDM-64/32-QAM using standard C-band components. Operation below SD-FEC is enabled by nonlinear transmitter pre-distortion based on coherent system identification supporting up to 150 nm bandwidth in the S-C-L-band.

articleTitle: InP-based PIC integrated with Butt-joint Coupled Waveguide p-i-n PDs for 100GBaud Coherent Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: InP-based PICs with waveguide p-i-n PDs for 100 GBaud coherent receivers are demonstrated. The wide 3-dB bandwidth of more than 65 GHz and high responsivity of 0.154 A/W are revealed at a wavelength of 1.55 μm. We successfully achieve the monolithic integration of 19 functions as InP-based PICs with a footprint of 10.7 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Deep Neural Network Equalizers Performance in Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a convolutional-recurrent channel equalizer and experimentally demonstrate 1dB Q-factor improvement both in single-channel and 96×WDM, DP-16QAM transmission over 450km of TWC fiber. The new equalizer outperforms previous NN-based approaches and a 3-steps-per-span DBP.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of an ultra-wide band (O to L) polymer thermo-optic switch matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-wide band (O to L) 4×4 polymer switch matrix is experimentally demonstrated. Results show <0.6dB polarization-dependent loss, >36dB switching ratio, <6.5dB fiber-to-fiber loss, and error-free operation with <0.15dB power penalty at 10Gb/s and 50Gb/s.

articleTitle: Performance Improvements in Bandwidth-Limited and Digitally-Equalized 50G-PON Downstream Transmission via Block-Interleaving over Four LDPC Codewords
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally quantify the performance improvements in bandwidth-limited 50G-PON downstream transmission with receiver-side equalization based on FFE, DFE and MLSE, by bit-interleaving of every four adjacent LDPC codewords, achieving 32-dB power budget with additional margins.

articleTitle: 99.999% Transmission Reliability based on MAC layer Feedback-repeat Scheme for LiFi Networking with B5G/6G
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A degenerated MAC layer feedback-repeat reliable transmission scheme was proposed and experimentally demonstrated for LiFi networking with B5G/6G. The experimental results of end-to-end packet loss ratio precedes 1/10000 (equals to 99.999% reliability).

articleTitle: Hollow-core fiber Characterization with Correlation-Optical Time Domain Reflectometry
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a Correlation-OTDR, we characterized the temperature-induced group delay variations of two nested antiresonant nodeless hollow core fibers. The temperature sensitivity of both is substantially less than for SSMF with some dependency on coating type.

articleTitle: Polarization-transparent FSR-free microring resonator filter with wide hitless tunability
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A coupled microring resonator architecture with non-integer Vernier ratio design and controllable loss is exploited to implement a polarization-transparent hitless tunable FSR-free filter operating over the extended C+L band (1520 nm–1620 nm).

articleTitle: Fully-Loaded Operation of 0.29-pJ/bit Wall-plug Efficiency, 81.9-Tb/s Throughput 32 × 32 Silicon Photonics Switch
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 16-ch. × 32-Gbaud QPSK/probabilistically-shaped-64QAM WDM transmission by three/nine cyclic propagations through a fully-loaded 32×32 silicon photonics switch. Its nine-stage Clos network will have a throughput of 125 Pb/s (131,072 ports × 0.952 Tb/s). © 2021 The Authors

articleTitle: How IBN can be Embedded within Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Deployment of business intent across the optical network through policies for automated management is introduced through illustrative examples spanning from connection provisioning, dynamic network adaptation, and connection degradation and failure localization.

articleTitle: Record high-order mode-division-multiplexed transmission on chip using gradient-duty-cycle subwavelength gratings
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 16-channel mode (de)multiplexers on a silicon chip using gradientduty-cycle subwavelength gratings. A 1.51-Tbit/s/polarization/wavelength capacity is achieved at 1550 nm with 7 neighboring 50-GHz spaced ASE channels.

articleTitle: High Speed, Low Voltage Polarization Controller Based on Heterogeneous Integration of Silicon and Lithium Niobate
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high speed, low voltage polarization controller based on Si-LN heterogeneous integration is fabricated and characterized. V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> of 3.2 - 5.2 V is realized in a frequency range of 60 Hz to 6 MHz.

articleTitle: Coupled-Channel Enhanced SSFM for Digital Backpropagation in WDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel technique for digital backpropagation (DBP) in wavelength-division multiplexing systems is introduced and shown, by simulations, to outperform existing DBP techniques for approximately the same complexity.

articleTitle: Scalable and Compact 3D Tensorized Photonic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a scalable and compact 3D tensorized photonic neural network with high-radix (1024×1024) synaptic interconnections implemented by cascaded small-radix (10×10) photonic tensor-train cores. Our architecture exhibits 171.8-dB lower insertion loss and 582× fewer MZIs.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Tunable, Broadband Pixel-Array-based Photonic-Integrated-Circuit Receiver for Recovering Two 100-Gbit/s QPSK Orbital-Angular-Momentum Multiplexed Channels
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate recovering two 100-Gbit/s QPSK OAM-multiplexed channels by using a pixel-array-based integrated receiver. It can be tuned to receive OAM ℓ = +1 or ℓ = −1 with a ~6-nm bandwidth for achieving BER under 7% FEC limit.

articleTitle: Digital Predistortion Enhancement by Convolutional Neural Network for Probabilistic Shaped Discrete Multi-Tone Signal Transmission in Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 68.2-Gb/s net data-rate probabilistic shaped discrete multi-tone transmission in passive optical network with 11G-class devices. The convolutional-neural-network strengthens digital predistortion performance with 1.1-dB improvement of system sensitivity over linear pre-equalization.

articleTitle: Free Space Optical Communication for Low Earth Orbit Data Relay Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Commercial high-rate LEO data relay networks with lasercom crosslink technology are nearing fruition. Physical layer connections are demonstrated, but higher layer challenges remain: topology control, data Doppler shifts, and disruption management.

articleTitle: 8×8 Programmable Multi-Beam Pattern Projection Based on Multicast Silicon Photonic MEMS Switches
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an arbitrary 8×8 beam pattern projection system based on a programmable grating coupler array with a Fourier lens. The static power consumption and the reconfiguration time are below 1µW and 10µs, respectively.

articleTitle: Self-Homodyne Photonic Transmitter in a Monolithic InP Platform for RF Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a self-homodyne transmitter architecture, compactly realized as a monolithic InP system-on-chip analog photonic integrated circuit, with RF gain improvement >10 dB by using an actively-tuned optical bypass.

articleTitle: Photonic sensor and miniature interrogator based on cascaded silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel DBS interrogation technique for monolithic refractive index sensing and interrogating using cascaded microring resonators. The sensitivity is 125.1 nm/RIU and resolution is 7.760-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> RIU.

articleTitle: Dynamic Skew in Multi-Core Fibers: From Lab Measurements to Field Trials
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review recent works analyzing inter-core skew in multi-core fibers, com-paring the behaviors of spooled fibers in laboratory conditions with field deployed fibers.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Photonic Spiking Neural Network on a monolithic silicon CMOS photonic platform
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We designed, simulated, and taped-out a photonic spiking neural network on a monolithic silicon CMOS photonic platform. Benchmarking shows proposed PSNN outperforms other neuromorphic hardware with 21.09fJ/spike and 61.4 μW average power at MNIST experiment.

articleTitle: Tutorial: Programmable Photonics
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This article consists of a collection of slides from the author's conference presentation. The complete oral presentation in text form was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: 25-Gbit/s 100-km Transmission using 1358-nm-wavelength SOA Assisted Extended Reach EADFB Laser (AXEL) for 25 Gbit/s-class PON
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 25-Gbit/s non-return-to-zero (NRZ) transmissions were successfully extended to 100 km by using a 1358-nm-wavelength SOA integrated EADFB laser (AXEL) with an optical modulation amplitude (OMA) over 10.5 dBm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 28-GHz Band Radio Signal Transmission into Vehicle by Analog Radio over Multi-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate transmitting 28-GHz band radio signals from cascaded IFoF based C-RAN mobile fronthaul system to inside a vehicle by re-radiation of the cost-effective analog radio over multi-mode fiber employing a directly modulated VCSEL.

articleTitle: Adaptive and Iterative QoT Estimator Retraining for Launch Power Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We dynamically optimize the transponders launch powers with iterative closed control loops. We close the loop after an adaptable number of algorithm’s intermediate calculations, to monitor and retrain the QoT estimator with the real world.

articleTitle: High-performance Silicon Quadplexer for Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We realized the first silicon quadplexer with low excess losses of ~0.5 dB and the desired bandwidths (i.e., 16/38/19/6 nm) for the wavelength-channels of 1270/1310/1490/1577 nm using multimode-waveguide-grating-based filters.

articleTitle: Thermo-optic Mach–Zehnder Interferometer Integrated with Si PN Diode Switch for Bipolar Optical Phase Control
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated the bipolar phase control in Mach–Zehnder interferometer by serial connection of TiN heaters and PN diodes. We achieved ±2π phase shift with single electrical signal, and pulse amplitude modulation for time-multiplexed control.

articleTitle: DAC-less and DSP-free 20 Gb/s PAM-4 transmission based on a dual modulation scheme using DML and external modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The generation of DAC-less 20 Gb/s PAM-4 using a DML and an external modulator is demonstrated. This dual modulation scheme has been transmitted up to 75-km SSMF with similar performance to PAM-4 DAC transmitter.

articleTitle: Entanglement Assisted Communication vs. Classical Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that under imperfect preshared entanglement-distribution, entanglement-assisted (EA) communication can be inferior compared to classical communication. When both signal and idler channels are used for classical transmission then classical capacity is always higher than EA-capacity.

articleTitle: Edge-based 5G Network Architectures in support of Zero Downtime Mobility for Enterprise Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ultra-Reliable Low Latency 5G applications require Edge implementation deep in access networks, resulting in the need for inter-Edge Server application mobility. This paper identifies implementation methodology for zero-downtime Edge application mobility.

articleTitle: Photonic Spiking VCSEL Neurons using Multi-Frequency Switching
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an approach to generate neuron-like spikes of VCSELs by multi-frequency switching. A frequency modulation is realized by numerical simulation to obtain stable spiking response of up to 1 Gbps.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an Integrated Photonic Magic T – a Robust Beam Splitter and Novel Polarization Diversity Building Block
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an adiabatic magic T in a 45 nm CMOS photonics foundry platform, with 3±0.25 dB power splitting and <1.2 dB loss over 1530-1600 nm, with a 60 µm-long device. It functions as a 2×2 beam splitter with splitting ratio from both input ports fundamentally robust by symmetry, and supports novel polarization diversity and modulator designs.

articleTitle: Impact of Aperture Size on Beam Evolution of Optical Phased Arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the beam evolution of optical phased arrays. The model is validated with a 1-cm-long grating antenna and applied to both large-scale arrays and long antennas for its impact.

articleTitle: Demonstration and Fabrication Tolerance Study of a Low-Loss, Ultra-broadband Rapid Adiabatic 3-dB Coupler in a Next-Generation 45 nm Monolithic Electronic-Photonic Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a rapid adiabatic coupler (RAC) with 50±1.08% power splitting ratio over 100 nm and insertion loss <0.2 dB at 1290 nm. We measure the device over seven reticles and show low variations in splitting ratio and insertion loss across the wafer.

articleTitle: Multi-core Fiber Technology for SDM: Coupling Mechanisms and Design
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Background: Why Space Division Multiplexing (SDM)?

articleTitle: Performance Prediction of 100 Gb/s PAM4 Optical Systems Using a Frequency Dependent Nonlinear Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A frequency-dependent nonlinear model has been proposed and experimentally verified at 100 Gb/s using PAM4. This universal model simply requires adjusting two sets of polynomials based on the THD data and is modulation format agnostic.

articleTitle: High-Speed MIMO Communication and Simultaneous Energy Harvesting Using Novel Organic Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A data rate of 363-Mb/s is achieved in a multiple-input-multiple-output experiment using 4 organic photovoltaics as receivers. The same system simultaneously extracted 10.9-mW. The resulting system model predicts 133-Gb/s using a 1000-cell organic solar panel. © 2021 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 4096-ary Eigenvalue Modulation Using 12 Triangular-lattice-shaped Eigenvalues
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the transmission of a 4096-ary eigenvalue-modulated signal using 12 triangular-lattice-shaped eigenvalues. A 50-km transmission with a BER < 3.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> at 11.25 Gb/s is achieved successfully.

articleTitle: 1060nm single-mode metal aperture VCSEL array with transverse resonance for 5km single-mode fiber transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 5km-long single-mode fiber transmission using 1060nm single-mode intracavity-metal-aperture VCSEL array with over 46Gbps modulations. The metal-aperture causes transverse-resonance, resulting in single-mode operation and bandwidth enhancement. The effective bandwidth is improved thanks to the negative dispersion.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Nanoseconds Optical Switch based Disaggregated Data Center Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A disaggregated DCN prototype based on nanoseconds optical switch is experimentally assessed. Results show a network latency of 122.3ns, no packet loss, and error-free operation with power penalty of 0.5dB at BER of 1E-9.

articleTitle: Large-scale Silicon Photonics Focal Plane Switch Array for Optical Beam Steering
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on 128×128-element two-dimensional silicon photonics focal plane switch arrays with microelectromechanical-system optical switches for random-access optical beam steering. A 70°×70° field-of-view and sub-MHz steering speed are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Meta-objective with sub-micrometer resolution for microendoscopes
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a meta-objective based on cascaded metalens. It can achieve sub-micrometer resolution in wide field of view. Combined with fiber bundle microscope system, the single cell contour of biological tissue can be clearly observed.

articleTitle: Real-time MIMO-DSP Technologies for SDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement an FPGA-based real-time MIMO-DSP for equalizing spatial modes and polarizations. With MIMO-DSP, we demonstrate real-time transmission over weakly coupled 10-mode fibers and strongly coupled 4-core fibers using WDM DP-QPSK signals.

articleTitle: High-speed transmissions with direct-modulation room-temperature semiconductor lasers emitting in the transparency window around 4 μm
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally realize a free-space transmission over one meter with room-temperature quantum cascade lasers and interband cascade lasers. With direct electrical modulation and raw analysis, the data-rate of the real-time transmission outperforms similar reported schemes.

articleTitle: 850-nm Dual-Mode VCSEL Carried 53-Gbps NRZ-OOK Transmission in 100-m Graded-Index Single-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated transmission of 850-nm dual-mode VCSEL carried NRZ-OOK data at 53 Gbit/s over 100 m graded-index single-mode fiber through heterogeneous mode-field mismatched coupling from lensed MMF with 40% efficiency or 4dB loss.

articleTitle: First Scalable Machine Learning Based Architecture for Cloud-native Transport SDN Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a cloud-native architecture with a machine learning QoT predictor that enables cognitive functions in transport SDN controllers. We evaluate the QoT predictor training and auto-scaling capabilities in a real WDM/SDM testbed.

articleTitle: Optical-phased array beam-steering using multi-input slab coupler in silicon nitride waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 2D beam-steering optical phased array is demonstrated in SiN. The multiple-input slab-coupler reduces OPA footprint 8x versus previous single-input designs. Measured field of view is 15° x 2.8°. Gaussian beam full-width is 0.36° x 0.175°.

articleTitle: Li-poster: Real-time Non-line-of-sight Optical Camera Communication for Hand-held Smartphone Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time flicker-free optical camera communication system that allows retrieval of descriptions from the complex optical signals reflected by an exhibition poster or artwork using a hand-held smartphone.

articleTitle: Passive Positioning using Visible Light Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Passive indoor visible light localization detects changes in illumination patterns in a room to infer the position of a user. We present analytical bounds on positioning error of an object in an indoor scenario and use deep learning to estimate positioning in realistic scenarios.

articleTitle: Optical Networks for Memory-driven Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Memory-driven computing, heterogeneous computing, and disaggregated system designs require photonic links having different characteristics than those found in hyperscale networks. Future architectures are discussed, requirements identified, an example system is examined, and conclusions presented.

articleTitle: Assessment of an SOA for Burst Mode Pre-Amplification in Higher Speed PON reaching 30dB of Optical Budget
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We perform a 30dB optical budget burst mode transmission at 25Gbit/s with an EML and a DC-30GHz PIN pre-amplified with an SOA. We demonstrate that the SOA does not deteriorate the quality of the transmission.

articleTitle: Carrier-recovery-free KK detection for PDM-bipolar-PAM in 100 Gb/s simplified coherent PON
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate, for the first time, carrier-recovery-free KK detection for a PDM-bipolar-PAM signal in simplified coherent TDM-PON. 32 dB power budget is achieved for the 100-Gbps signal after 25km downstream transmission.

articleTitle: Carrier Enhancement for Multichannel Kramers–Kronig Detection via Self-Seeded Brillouin Amplification
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate performance improvement of 5×10-Gbaud 16-QAM single-sideband signals using a carrier recovery block enabled by self-seeded Brillouin amplification after 80-km fiber transmission. The optimum average Q factor improvement is 3.0 dB.

articleTitle: Microwave Frequency Comb Generation Based on Active Mode-Locking of a Polarization-Multiplexed Dual Loop Optoelectronic Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A photonics-assisted microwave frequency comb (MFC) generator based on a polarization-multiplexed dual loop optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) is proposed. Experimental results demonstrate the generated MFC has adjustable comb interval and low phase noise.

articleTitle: Jointly Shaped Dual Polarization Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a probabilistic shaping algorithm whereby both polarization streams of a dual-polarized system are shaped together. The proposed method offers 0.2-0.92 dB gains over existing shaping schemes for the same block-length.

articleTitle: Advanced Direct Detection Schemes
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this tutorial, we review various advanced direct detection schemes to bridge the gap between conventional direct and coherent detection. We show such schemes may play an important role for future ultrahigh-speed short-reach applications.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Programmable 100 Gb/s SDN-Enabled Encryptors/Decryptors for QKD Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated on-demand and programmable encryption/decryption using SDN-enabled FPGA-based technology over a QKD network. Data rate over 90 Gb/s with maximum data encryption of 11.25 GB/s for different encryption schemes were achieved.

articleTitle: Fiber lasers with regular and random distributed feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review our recent results on fiber lasers with distributed feedback based on π-shifted or random fiber Bragg gratings, and random index structures inscribed by femtosecond pulses in singlemode or multicore/multimode fibers.

articleTitle: Fully Connected Entanglement-based Quantum Communication Network without Trusted Node
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a fully connected quantum communication network architecture based on multi-user entanglement distribution by space multiplexing and wavelength multiplexing technologies. A fully connected QKD network with 40 users was demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Self-tuning Bidirectional 50GBASE-ER Optical Transceiver based on Temperature Control and Silica-based Comb Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Error-free 24-hour real-time transmission of self-tuning bidirectional 50GBASE-ER QSFP28 point-to-point system over 40-km G.652.D fiber is demonstrated. With the upstream and downstream wavelength in same spectral band, the time-delay is reduced to 0.25 ns.

articleTitle: Inchworm-inspired Soft Robotic Climber with Embedded Fiber Optic Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An inchworm-inspired soft robotic climber with three embedded fiber Bragg grating sensors in the body is proposed and demonstrated. The grating sensors monitor the unique locomotion status of the climber for precise feedback and control.

articleTitle: Real-Time Unrepeatered C-Band Transmission of 30.5 Tb/s over 276.4 km and 29.45 Tb/s over 292.5 km
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present record unrepeatered experiments with 61 real-time 32-QAM channels at 500 Gb/s over 276.4 km, or with hybrid 16/32 QAM modulation over 292.5 km, applying a high-power booster and third-order Raman amplification.

articleTitle: Novel Link Architecture Minimizing Thermal Energy Dissipation for Cryogenic Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel cryogenic optical interconnect architecture and first demonstration is presented, using external laser tracking and ring resonator modulators – that provide both modulation and wavelength multiplexing – for scalable cryogenic interconnects with minimized thermal energy dissipation.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Time-Evolution Control Method to Improve the Performance of Optoelectronic Coherent Ising Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A simple dynamic time-evolution control method is proposed and experimentally demonstrated in an opto-electronic-oscillator based coherent Ising machine. The experimental results show significant performance improvement can be realized using this method at different parameter settings.

articleTitle: On the Comparison of Single-Carrier vs. Digital Multi-Carrier Signaling for Long-Haul Transmission of Probabilistically Shaped Constellation Formats
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on theoretical and experimental investigations of the nonlinear tolerance of single carrier and digital multicarrier approaches with probabilistically shaped constellations. Experimental transmission of PCS16QAM is assessed at 120 GBd over an ultra-long-haul distance.

articleTitle: 224-Gb/s 16QAM SV-DD Transmission Using Pilot-Assisted Polarization Recovery with Integrated Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a low-complexity pilot-assisted analytical method for polarization demultiplexing in SV-DD systems, achieving a 224-Gb/s 16QAM transmission over 40-km SSMF and can tolerate up to 75-krad/s RSOP at BTB.

articleTitle: Record Performance of 53GB Ge/Si Avalanche Photodiode ROSA
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 53GB Ge/Si APD TO-CAN ROSA were designed and fabricated with record breaking sensitivities of -23.2dBm at BER=1E-3 for 53GB NRZ and -16.0dBm at BER=2E-4 for 53GB PAM4, respectively.

articleTitle: Coherent optical communications using coherence-cloned Kerr soliton microcombs as carriers and local oscillators
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate cloning of two Kerr soliton combs via using the techniques of pump laser conveying and two-point locking. The cloned Kerr combs are used as carriers and local oscillators for coherent optical transmission.

articleTitle: Long-Term Reliable >200-Gb/s Directly Modulated Lasers with 800GbE-Compliant DSP
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the long-term reliable operation of a 70-GHz-class DFB+R laser and its capability of 108-GBd PAM-4 signaling under +4.8-ps/nm dispersion using ultra-low complexity equalizations as well as faster-than-Nyquist PAM-2 signaling up to 280 GBd.

articleTitle: Edge-Coupled Active and Passive Wafer-Scale Measurements on 300mm Silicon Photonics Wafers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We perform wafer-scale measurements of silicon photonics components using broadband (100nm+) edge couplers and reflecting optical fiber probes for the first time. We demonstrate <1dB/cm waveguide loss and 25GHz+ micro-ring modulators on 300mm wafers.

articleTitle: High-Performance Neuromorphic Computing Based on Photonic Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dedicated technology platforms gain interest for enhancing the performance and efficiency of neuromorphic computing. We demonstrate integrated optic devices for convolutional signal processing and neural network training.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal modulator in a CMOS foundry platform
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first photonic crystal microcavity modulator realized in a foundry CMOS photonics platform. Bandwidth of 2.8 GHz and 5 Gbps data rate demonstrated utilizing an interdigitated p-n junction in a WDM compatible structure.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network based Equalizer with Embedded Parallelization for 100Gbps/λ PON
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Recurrent neural network based equalizer with parallel outputs is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Result shows that it outperforms fully-connected neural network for 100Gbps/λ PON using 25G-class optics. Hardware implementation issues are also discussed.

articleTitle: Opto-Mechanical Inter-Core Crosstalk in Multi-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The constituent cores of multi-core fibers are coupled by acoustic modes, guided by the entire cladding cross-section. Acoustic coupling leads to inter core cross phase modulation. The effect is quantified in analysis and experiment.

articleTitle: Non-Abelian gauge fields with fiber optics and beyond
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We observe the non-Abelian Aharonov–Bohm effect by synthesizing non-Abelian gauge fields in a fiber-optic interferometer, enabled by multiple time-reversal symmetry breaking in orthogonal bases of the Hilbert space. Based on the realized building blocks of non-Abelian gauge fields, We introduce and study a type of non-Abelian Hofstadter models.

articleTitle: Performance of dual frequency comb channelizers for RF signal processing
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyse the performance limits of dual frequency comb based photonic signal processors. We show that the relative phase noise between the two combs is critical to defining the signal-to-noise-ratio of such systems.

articleTitle: Optical Interconnects for large scale computing: How Do We Get Beyond the Cost & Power Wall?
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Bandwidth demands for datacenter networks continues as performance increases and AI and new HPC workloads explode. Managing power and costs will require a range of solutions from new network architectures to co-packaging.

articleTitle: Theory of Spontaneous Emission Factors of Optical Parametric Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This study analyzes the effect of the internal loss of optical parametric amplifiers on their noise characteristics. Quantum-mechanical Langevin equations are used to derive theoretical expressions for the spontaneous emission factor for the first time.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Optical Cross-Connects with Flexible Waveband Routing Function for SDM Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally evaluate the transmission performance of OXC structures based on flexible-waveband routing. 1600 km, 700 km, and 600 km transmission is demonstrated using 32 Gbaud DP-QPSK, DP-8QAM, and DP-16QAM on 37.5 GHz grid, respectively.

articleTitle: C to C+L Bands Upgrade with Resource Re-provisioning in Optical Backbone Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Resource re-provisioning during network upgrade from C to C+L bands can optimize resource allocation and postpone upgrade cost. Results show re-provisioning shorter lightpaths to L band leads to a more cost-effective upgrade.

articleTitle: Lessons Learn from A Tactile Internet Testbed: An Access Network Perspective
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review TDM-PON based optical access for 5G and tactile internet applications, and introduce recent feasibility studies based on high-capacity and low latency TDM-PON. Lessons learned from the tactile internet testbed are also discussed.

articleTitle: Inverse-Designed InP-Based Polarization Rotator-Splitter
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A size-reduced InP-based inverse-designed polarization rotator-splitter is presented, being the first demonstration of a topology-optimized passive waveguide component on InP. The manufactured device has extinction ratios >10dB for both polarizations over the entire C-band.

articleTitle: Cryo-Compatible, Silicon Spoked-Ring Modulator in a 45nm CMOS Platform for 4K-to-Room-Temperature Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cryogenic operation, at 4.5K, of a vertical-junction silicon microring modulator in a 45 nm CMOS platform is demonstrated. Record resonance-shift efficiency – 46 GHz/V – enables nonthermal tuning in 140 GHz range and up to 10 Gbps OOK modulation with ≤1V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</inf> drive, paving the way to cryogenic optical data egress links.

articleTitle: VLC Using a Red SMD LED as 2.48 Gb/s Multi-Carrier Receiver and Wide Field-of-View 25 Mb/s OOK Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A single-color LED is used as transceiver, achieving 2.48 Gb/s downlink reception with laser pencil beam over 2 m, and 25 Mbaud uplink transmission using APD- and SPAD-based receivers over 1 and 2 m, respectively.

articleTitle: Robust polarization-insensitive C & L band FOPA with >17dB gain for both WDM and bursty traffic
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a real-time stabilized polarization-insensitive fiber optic parametric amplifier to simultaneously amplify WDM C&L band traffic in an extended-reach PON scenario with gain >17dB and output power >23 dBm.

articleTitle: 224-Gb/s PAM4 Uncooled Operation of Lumped-electrode EA-DFB Lasers with 2-km Transmission for 800GbE Application
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Newly developed lumped-electrode (LE) EA-DFB lasers demonstrated 224-Gb/s PAM4 uncooled operation with 2-km transmission. Its average output power and TDECQ from 20 to 80°C are respectively more than 6 dBm and less than 2.8 dB.

articleTitle: Auto-Aligned OWC Receiver for Indoor Mobile Users using Gradient Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed a new auto-aligned optical wireless receiver for indoor mobile users using a dual-axis actuator, a motion sensor, and a feedback control. Experiments demonstrate seamless transmission at normal walking speeds with <400ms alignment time.

articleTitle: Non-Volatile Operation of a Si PN Ring Resonator with a Ferroelectric Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated the non-volatile operation of a Si PN ring resonator with a ferroelectric HfZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> capacitor. Due to the polarization in the HfZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> capacitor, the resonance wavelength of the ring resonator shows the bi-stable operation.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an SDN-enabled VCSEL-based Photonic System for Spectral/Spatial Connectivity in Disaggregated Optical Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This demo showcases an SDN control platform configuring VCSEL-based photonic transceiver and white-box nodes for end-to-end programmability in disaggregated optical metro networks also including the spatial dimension with a polymer switch and 25km 19-core MCF.

articleTitle: Integrated Microwave Photonic Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Microwave signal filtering is a fundamental and central functionality in radio frequency systems. We review the principles, architectures, and superior performance of emerging integrated microwave photonic filters enabled by on-chip linear and nonlinear photonic devices.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Apodized Bragg Grating Filter Fabricated in a Silicon Photonic Foundry
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Apodized Bragg grating filters offer unique advantages yet require precise fabrication tolerances. We demonstrate a CMOS foundry fabricated widely tunable filter with a sharp edge roll-off of 35dB/nm, a flat 20nm transmission band and low-loss.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Based Stacked Die Assembly for 4×200-Gbit/s Short-Reach Transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
